```ts
import { type Pattern, } from "../parser/pattern.ts";

/**
 * TokenDoc — armazena nome e descrição de um token usado pelo parser sintático.
 *
 * @see docs/taskjuggler/lib/taskjuggler/TextParser/TokenDoc.rb
 */
export class TokenDoc {
  readonly name: string | null;
  readonly text: string | null;
  readonly typeSpec: string | null;
  readonly pattern: Pattern | null;

  constructor(name: string | null, arg: string | Pattern,) {
    this.name = name;
    if (typeof arg === "string") {
      this.text = arg;
      this.pattern = null;
    } else {
      this.text = null;
      this.pattern = arg;
    }
    this.typeSpec = null;
  }
}
```

## File: `packages/core/src/log.ts`

```ts
export class Log {
  static level: number = 0;
  static stack: string[] = [];
  static segments: string[] = [];
  static silent: boolean = false;
  static progressPct: number = 0;
  static progressMeter: string = '';

  static enter(segment: string, message: string): void {
    this.stack.push(segment);
    this.segments.push(`${segment}: ${message}`);
    if (this.level > 0) {
      const last = this.segments[this.segments.length - 1];
      if (last) {
        console.error(this.formatMessage(last));
      }
    }
  }

  static exit(segment: string, message?: string): void {
    if (this.stack.length > 0 && this.stack[this.stack.length - 1] === segment) {
      this.stack.pop();
    }
    if (message) {
      this.segments.push(`${segment}: ${message}`);
      if (this.level > 0) {
        console.error(this.formatMessage(`${segment}: ${message}`));
      }
    }
  }

  static msg(block: () => string): void {
    if (this.level > 0) {
      const result = block();
      console.error(this.formatMessage(result));
    }
  }

  static status(message: string): void {
    if (this.level > 0) {
      console.error(this.formatMessage(message));
    }
  }

  static startProgressMeter(text: string): void {
    if (!this.silent && Deno?.stderr?.isTerminal()) {
      this.progressMeter = text;
      console.error(this.formatMessage(`[${text}]`));
    }
  }

  static stopProgressMeter(): void {
    if (this.progressMeter) {
      console.error(this.formatMessage(`[${this.progressMeter}] - concluído`));
      this.progressMeter = '';
    }
  }

  static activity(): void {
    if (this.silent) return;
    this.progressPct = (this.progressPct + 1) % 100;
    if (Deno?.stderr?.isTerminal()) {
      Deno.stdout.writeSync(new TextEncoder().encode(`\rProgress: ${this.progressPct}%`));
    }
  }

  static progress(percent: number): void {
    this.progressPct = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, percent));
    if (Deno?.stderr?.isTerminal()) {
      Deno.stdout.writeSync(new TextEncoder().encode(`\rProgress: ${this.progressPct}%`));
    }
  }

  static reset(): void {
    this.level = 0;
    this.stack = [];
    this.segments = [];
    this.silent = false;
    this.progressPct = 0;
    this.progressMeter = '';
  }

  private static formatMessage(message: string): string {
    const timestamp = new Date().toISOString();
    return `[${timestamp}] ${message}`;
  }
}
```

```ts
import { Message, MessageType, } from "./message.ts";
import { SourceFileInfo, } from "./source-file-info.ts";

export class MessageHandlerInstance {

  static get instance(): MessageHandlerInstance {
    if (!MessageHandlerInstance._instance) {
      MessageHandlerInstance._instance = new MessageHandlerInstance();
    }
    return MessageHandlerInstance._instance;
  }

  constructor() {
    if (MessageHandlerInstance._instance) {
      return MessageHandlerInstance._instance;
    }
    MessageHandlerInstance._instance = this;
  }

  reset(): void {
    this.messages = [];
    this.errors = 0;
    this.outputLevel = 2;
    this.logLevel = 2;
    this.logFile = null;
    this.hideScenario = false;
    this.abortOnWarning = false;
    this.baselineSFI = null;
    this.trapSetup = false;
  }

  clear(): void {
    this.messages = [];
    this.errors = 0;
  }

    id: string,
    message: string,
    sfi?: SourceFileInfo | null,
    line?: string | null,
    data?: unknown,
    scenario?: Scenario | null,
  ): never {
    this.addMessage("fatal", id, message, sfi, line, data, scenario,);
    this.errors++;
    throw new TjRuntimeError(`${id}: ${message}`,);
  }

  error(
    id: string,
    message: string,
    sfi?: SourceFileInfo | null,
    line?: string | null,
    data?: unknown,
    scenario?: Scenario | null,
  ): never {
    this.addMessage("error", id, message, sfi, line, data, scenario,);
    this.errors++;
    throw new TjRuntimeError(`${id}: ${message}`,);
  }

  critical(
    id: string,
    message: string,
    sfi?: SourceFileInfo | null,
    line?: string | null,
    data?: unknown,
    scenario?: Scenario | null,
  ): void {
    this.addMessage("error", id, message, sfi, line, data, scenario,);
    this.errors++;
  }

  warning(
    id: string,
    message: string,
    sfi?: SourceFileInfo | null,
    line?: string | null,
    data?: unknown,
    scenario?: Scenario | null,
  ): void {
    this.addMessage("warning", id, message, sfi, line, data, scenario,);
    if (this.abortOnWarning) {
      throw new TjRuntimeError(`${id}: ${message}`,);
    }
  }

  info(
    id: string,
    message: string,
    sfi?: SourceFileInfo | null,
    line?: string | null,
    data?: unknown,

  ): void {

  }

    id: string,
    message: string,
    sfi?: SourceFileInfo | null,
    line?: string | null,
    data?: unknown,
    scenario?: Scenario | null,
  ): void {

  }

  private addMessage(
    type: MessageType,
    id: string,
    message: string,
    sfi?: SourceFileInfo | null,
    line?: string | null,
    data?: unknown,
    scenario?: Scenario | null,
  ): void {
    const effectiveSfi = sfi ?? this.baselineSFI;
    const msg = new Message(
      type,
      id,
      message,
      effectiveSfi,
      line,
      data,
      scenario,
    );

  to_s(): string {
    return this.messages.map((m,) => m.to_s()).join("\n",);
  }
```

```ts
import { SourceFileInfo } from "./source-file-info.ts";
import { TjRuntimeError } from "./model/errors.ts";
import { Scenario } from "./model/scenario.ts";

export type MessageType = 'fatal' | 'error' | 'warning' | 'info' | 'debug';

export class Message {
  readonly type: MessageType;
  readonly id: string;
  readonly message: string;
  sourceFileInfo: SourceFileInfo | null;
  readonly line: string | null;
  readonly data: unknown;
  readonly scenario: Scenario | null;

  constructor(
    type: MessageType,
    id: string,
    message: string,
    sfi?: SourceFileInfo | null,
    line?: string | null,
    data?: unknown,
    scenario?: Scenario | null,
  ) {
    this.type = type;
    this.id = id;
    this.message = message;
    this.sourceFileInfo = sfi ?? null;
    this.line = line ?? null;
    this.data = data;
    this.scenario = scenario ?? null;
  }

  to_s(): string {
    const colorCodes = {
      fatal: '\x1b[31m',
      error: '\x1b[31m',
      warning: '\x1b[33m',
      info: '\x1b[36m',
      debug: '\x1b[90m',
    };
    const reset = '\x1b[0m';
    const color = colorCodes[this.type] || '';
    let result = `${color}${this.id}: ${this.message}${reset}`;
    if (this.sourceFileInfo) {
      result += ` [${this.sourceFileInfo.to_s()}]`;
    }
    return result;
  }

  to_log(): string {
    return `${this.type.toUpperCase()}: ${this.id}: ${this.message}`;
  }
}
```

```ts
import { ScenarioData, } from "./scenario-data.ts";
import { type PropertyLike, } from "./property-like.ts";
import { type AttributeBase, } from "../attributes/attribute-base.ts";
import { type Account, } from "./account.ts";
import { type ProjectLike, } from "./project-like.ts";
import { type AccountCredit, } from "../finance/account-credit.ts";
import { type TjTime, } from "../time/tj-time.ts";
import { PropertyTreeNode, } from "./property-tree-node.ts";
import { TjInternalError, } from "./errors.ts";

/**
 * Interface para query de relatório (balance/turnover).
 *
 * Obrigatório: start, end, sortable, numerical, string, currencyFormat.
 *
 * @see docs/taskjuggler/lib/taskjuggler/AccountScenario.rb#query_balance
 */
export interface Query {
  readonly start: TjTime;
  readonly end: TjTime;
  sortable: number;
  numerical: number;
  string: string;
  readonly currencyFormat: {
    format(amount: number,): string;
  };
}

/**
 * Interface para subtotais por tipo (task/resource/material).
 */
export interface AccountBuckets {
  task: number;
  resource: number;
  material: number;
}

/**
 * Lista exata de atributos pré-carregados pelo AccountScenario do Ruby
 * (AccountScenario.rb, linhas 17–20).
 */
export const ACCOUNT_SCENARIO_ATTRS: string[] = ["credits",];

export class AccountScenario extends ScenarioData {
  private buckets: AccountBuckets = { task: 0, resource: 0, material: 0, };

  constructor(
    account: unknown,
    scIdx: number,
    attributes: Map<string, AttributeBase<unknown>>,
  ) {
    super(
      account as PropertyLike,
      scIdx,
      attributes,
    );
    this.preloadAttributes(ACCOUNT_SCENARIO_ATTRS,);
  }

  /**
   * Obtém o valor de um atributo da conta (não do cenário), incluindo
   * herança e valores padrão. Usado para atributos como 'aggregate'.
   */
  getAccountAttribute(id: string,): unknown {
    return (this.property as PropertyTreeNode).get(id,);
  }

  /**
   * Calcula o turnover para o período entre _startIdx_ e _endIdx_.
   *
   * Replicando o método Ruby `AccountScenario#turnover`.
   *
   * @see docs/taskjuggler/lib/taskjuggler/AccountScenario.rb#turnover
   */
  turnover(startIdx: number, endIdx: number,): number {
    // Reset buckets a cada chamada.
    this.buckets = { task: 0, resource: 0, material: 0, };

    let amount = 0.0;

    // 1. Credits (manuais)
    const credits = this.a("credits",) as AccountCredit[];
    if (credits && credits.length > 0) {
      const project =
        (this.property as PropertyLike & { project: ProjectLike }).project;
      const startDate = project.idxToDate(startIdx,);
      const endDate = project.idxToDate(endIdx,);
      for (const credit of credits) {
        if (startDate <= credit.date && credit.date < endDate) {
          amount += credit.amount;
        }
      }
    }

    // 2. Container logic (filhos ou meta-account)
    const property = this.property as PropertyLike & {
      container?: () => boolean;
      adoptees?: PropertyLike[];
      children?: PropertyLike[];
    };
    if (property.container?.()) {
      const adoptees = property.adoptees ?? [];
      if (adoptees.length === 0) {
        // Normal case: accumulate turnover of child accounts
        for (const child of property.children ?? []) {
          const childAccount = child as unknown as Account;
          const childAmount = childAccount.scenarioData(this.scenarioIdx,)
            .turnover(startIdx, endIdx,);
          amount += childAmount;
          // Buckets herdam dos filhos.
          const childBuckets = childAccount.scenarioData(this.scenarioIdx,)
            .getBuckets();
          this.buckets.task += childBuckets.task;
          this.buckets.resource += childBuckets.resource;
          this.buckets.material += childBuckets.material;
        }
      } else {
        // Special case for meta account used to calculate a balance.
        // The first adoptee is the top-level cost account, the second the top-level revenue account.
        const costAmount = -(adoptees[0] as unknown as Account).scenarioData(
          this.scenarioIdx,
        ).turnover(startIdx, endIdx,);
        const revenueAmount = (adoptees[1] as unknown as Account).scenarioData(
          this.scenarioIdx,
        ).turnover(startIdx, endIdx,);
        amount += costAmount + revenueAmount;
        const costBuckets = (adoptees[0] as unknown as Account).scenarioData(
          this.scenarioIdx,
        ).getBuckets();
        const revenueBuckets = (adoptees[1] as unknown as Account).scenarioData(
          this.scenarioIdx,
        ).getBuckets();
        this.buckets.task += -costBuckets.task + revenueBuckets.task;
        this.buckets.resource += -costBuckets.resource +
          revenueBuckets.resource;
        this.buckets.material += -costBuckets.material +
          revenueBuckets.material;
      }
    } else {
      // Leaf: aggregate by type (tasks or resources)
      const aggregate = this.getAccountAttribute("aggregate",) as string;
      const project =
        (this.property as PropertyLike & { project: ProjectLike }).project;

      if (aggregate === "tasks") {
        project.tasks.each((task,) => {
          // Cast to Account to access scenarioData, then to TaskScenario for turnover with 5 args
          const taskAccount = task as unknown as Account;
          const taskScenario = taskAccount.scenarioData(
            this.scenarioIdx,
          ) as unknown as {
            turnover(
              startIdx: number,
              endIdx: number,
              account: unknown,
              resource: unknown,
              includeKids: boolean,
            ): number;
          };
          const taskAmount = taskScenario.turnover(
            startIdx,
            endIdx,
            this.property,
            null,
            false,
          );
          amount += taskAmount;
          this.buckets.task += taskAmount;
        },);
      } else if (aggregate === "resources") {
        project.resources.each((resource,) => {
          if (resource.leaf?.()) {
            const resourceAccount = resource as unknown as Account;
            const resourceScenario = resourceAccount.scenarioData(
              this.scenarioIdx,
            ) as unknown as {
              turnover(
                startIdx: number,
                endIdx: number,
                account: unknown,
                resource: unknown,
                includeKids: boolean,
              ): number;
            };
            const resourceAmount = resourceScenario.turnover(
              startIdx,
              endIdx,
              this.property,
              null,
              false,
            );
            amount += resourceAmount;
            this.buckets.resource += resourceAmount;
          }
        },);
      } else if (aggregate === "materials") {
        // Material aggregation: sum totalCost of all materials.
        project.resources.each?.((material,) => {
          const materialObj = material as unknown as {
            totalCost?: () => number;
          };
          if (typeof materialObj.totalCost === "function") {
            const materialAmount = materialObj.totalCost();
            amount += materialAmount;
            this.buckets.material += materialAmount;
          }
        },);
      } else {
        throw new Error(`Unknown aggregation type ${aggregate}`,);
      }
    }

    // Bloco I: Popula buckets a partir de CostEvents emitidos pelo motor de atribuição
    // Este é o novo comportamento para contas leaf (não container)
    if (!property.container?.()) {
      const project =
        (this.property as PropertyLike & { project: ProjectLike }).project;
      const scIdx = this.scenarioIdx;
      const account = this.property as unknown as Account;

      // Filtrar CostEvents para este cenário e conta (ou seus filhos)
      for (const event of project.costEvents) {
        if (event.scenarioIdx !== scIdx) continue;
        if (!event.account) continue;
        // Verificar se o evento pertence a esta conta ou a um filho
        if (
          event.account === account ||
          (event.account as any).isChildOf?.(account,)
        ) {
          // Classificar por tipo
          switch (event.type) {
            case "task_charge":
              this.buckets.task += event.amount;
              break;
            case "resource_effort":
              this.buckets.resource += event.amount;
              break;
            case "material_usage":
              this.buckets.material += event.amount;
              break;
          }
        }
      }
    }

    return amount;
  }

  /**
   * Retorna os buckets atuais (última chamada de turnover).
   */
  getBuckets(): AccountBuckets {
    return { ...this.buckets, };
  }

  /**
   * Calcula o turnover por tipo (task/resource/material).
   *
   * @see docs/taskjuggler/lib/taskjuggler/AccountScenario.rb#turnover
   */
  turnoverByType(
    startIdx: number,
    endIdx: number,
    type: "task" | "resource" | "material",
  ): number {
    this.turnover(startIdx, endIdx,);
    switch (type) {
      case "task":
        return this.buckets.task;
      case "resource":
        return this.buckets.resource;
      case "material":
        return this.buckets.material;
      default:
        throw new TjInternalError(`Unknown cost type ${type as string}`,);
    }
  }

  /**
   * Popula um query de balance (startIdx = 0, endIdx = dateToIdx(query.start)).
   *
   * @see docs/taskjuggler/lib/taskjuggler/AccountScenario.rb#query_balance
   */
  query_balance(query: Query,): void {
    const project =
      (this.property as PropertyLike & { project: ProjectLike }).project;
    const startIdx = 0;
    const endIdx = project.dateToIdx(query.start,);
    const amount = this.turnover(startIdx, endIdx,);

    query.sortable = amount;
    query.numerical = amount;
    query.string = query.currencyFormat.format(amount,);
  }

  /**
   * Popula um query de turnover (startIdx = dateToIdx(query.start), endIdx = dateToIdx(query.end)).
   *
   * @see docs/taskjuggler/lib/taskjuggler/AccountScenario.rb#query_turnover
   */
  query_turnover(query: Query,): void {
    const project =
      (this.property as PropertyLike & { project: ProjectLike }).project;
    const startIdx = project.dateToIdx(query.start,);
    const endIdx = project.dateToIdx(query.end,);
    const amount = this.turnover(startIdx, endIdx,);

    query.sortable = amount;
    query.numerical = amount;
    query.string = query.currencyFormat.format(amount,);
  }
}
```

## File: `packages/core/src/model/account.ts`

```ts
import { type ProjectLike, } from "./project-like.ts";
import { PropertyTreeNode, } from "./property-tree-node.ts";
import { AccountScenario, } from "./account-scenario.ts";

type CostType = 'task' | 'resource' | 'material';

export type { CostType };

export class Account extends PropertyTreeNode {
  private allowedTypes: Set<CostType> = new Set();

  constructor(
    project: ProjectLike,
    id: string | null,
    name: string,
    parent: Account | null,
  ) {
    super(project.accounts, id, name, parent,);
    project.addAccount(this,);
    for (let i = 0; i < project.scenarioCount; i++) {
      this.data[i] = new AccountScenario(
        this,
        i,
        this.getScenarioAttributes(i,),
      );
    }
  }

  override scenarioData(scIdx: number,): AccountScenario {
    return this.data[scIdx]! as AccountScenario;
  }

  canAccept(type: CostType): boolean {
    return this.allowedTypes.size === 0 || this.allowedTypes.has(type);
  }

  setAllowedTypes(types: CostType[]): void {
    this.allowedTypes = new Set(types);
  }

  getAllowedTypes(): CostType[] {
    return Array.from(this.allowedTypes);
  }
}
```

```ts
/**
 * Erro base para todos os erros do sistema de atributos.
 */
export class TjError extends Error {
  constructor(message: string) {
    super(message);
    this.name = "TjError";
  }
}

/**
 * Erro de argumento inválido — usado para validação de parâmetros.
 */
export class TjArgumentError extends TjError {
  constructor(message: string) {
    super(message);
    this.name = "TjArgumentError";
  }
}

/**
 * Erro de execução — usado para falhas durante a execução normal.
 */
export class TjRuntimeError extends TjError {
  constructor(message: string) {
    super(message);
    this.name = "TjRuntimeError";
  }
}

/**
 * Erro interno — usado para situações impossíveis.
 */
export class TjInternalError extends TjError {
  constructor(message: string) {
    super(message);
    this.name = "TjInternalError";
  }
}

/**
 * Erro quando um atributo tenta sobrescrever um valor já definido.
 */
export class AttributeOverwrite extends TjArgumentError {
  constructor(attributeId: string) {
    super(`Attribute '${attributeId}' já está definido`);
    this.name = "AttributeOverwrite";
  }
}

/**
 * Erro para métodos que dependem de fases futuras.
 */
export class NotYetImplementedError extends TjRuntimeError {
  constructor(phase: string, method: string) {
    super(`O método '${method}' depende da Fase ${phase}`);
    this.name = "NotYetImplementedError";
  }
}
```

```ts
import { TjTime, } from "../time/tj-time.ts";
import { TimeInterval, } from "../time/time-interval.ts";

/**
 * Tipos de extended booking — o que o booking registra efetivamente.
 *
 * @see docs/syntaxmesh/fases/fase-8.1-nova-funcionalidade-custos.md
 */
export type ExtendedBookingType = "effort" | "charge" | "material";

/**
 * Representa um booking estendido que registra o que efetivamente aconteceu
 * (esforço, charge ou material) em um cenário específico.
 *
 * Semelhante a um booking original, mas com suporte para charge e material
 * além de effort.
 */
export class ExtendedBooking {
  readonly type: ExtendedBookingType;
  readonly value: number;
  readonly date: TjTime;
  readonly interval?: TimeInterval;
  readonly scenarioIdx?: number;

  constructor(
    type: ExtendedBookingType,
    value: number,
    date: TjTime,
    interval?: TimeInterval,
    scenarioIdx?: number,
  ) {
    this.type = type;
    this.value = value;    this.date = date;
    this.interval = interval;
    this.scenarioIdx = scenarioIdx;

    // Validação
    // Permitir valores negativos para charge (custo monetário), mas não para effort/material
    if (type === "charge" && value < 0) {
      // charge pode ser negativo (custo)
    } else if (type !== "charge" && value < 0) {
      throw new Error(`Extended booking ${type} value cannot be negative: ${value}`);
    }

    if (type === "effort" && interval && interval.duration() < 0) {
      throw new Error("Extended booking effort interval cannot have negative duration");
    }
  }

  /**
   * Cópia profunda imutável.
   * Retorna this (imutável) para compatibilidade com deepClone.
   */
  deepClone(): this {
    return this;
  }
}

```

## File: `packages/core/src/model/extended-charge.ts`

```ts
/**
 * Modificador de extended charge — define como um valor monetário é distribuído
 * no tempo durante a execução de uma tarefa.
 *
 * @see docs/syntaxmesh/fases/fase-8.1-nova-funcionalidade-custos.md
 */
export type ExtendedChargeModifier =
  | "onstart"
  | "onend"
  | "perhour"
  | "perday"
  | "perweek"
  | "permonth"
  | "distributed"
  | "distribution";

/**
 * Representa uma charge estendida com distribuição temporal não-linear.
 *
 * Semelhante a `MaterialAllocation`, mas para valores monetários.
 */
export class ExtendedCharge {
  readonly amount: number;
  readonly modifier: ExtendedChargeModifier;
  readonly distribution?: number[];

  constructor(
    amount: number,
    modifier: ExtendedChargeModifier,
    distribution?: number[],
  ) {
    this.amount = amount;
    this.modifier = modifier;
    this.distribution = distribution;

    // Validação
    if (distribution) {
      const sum = distribution.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);
      if (Math.abs(sum - 1.0) > 0.001) {
        throw new Error(
          `Extended charge distribution must sum to 1.0, got ${sum}`,
        );
      }
    }
  }

  /**
   * Cópia profunda imutável.
   * Retorna this (imutável) para compatibilidade com deepClone.
   */
  deepClone(): this {
    return this;
  }
}
```

```ts
/**
 * Journal e JournalEntry (porta mínima para o parser — Fase 10).
 *
 * Port parcial de `docs/taskjuggler/lib/taskjuggler/Journal.rb`. A
 * renderização de relatórios (`to_rText`, query handlers) pertence à
 * Fase 14/16; aqui ficam apenas os dados que o parser preenche.
 */
import type { TjTime, } from "../time/tj-time.ts";
import type { SourceFileInfo, } from "../source-file-info.ts";
import type { PropertyTreeNode, } from "./property-tree-node.ts";

export class JournalEntry {
  readonly journal: Journal;
  readonly date: TjTime;
  readonly headline: string;
  readonly property: PropertyTreeNode | null;
  readonly sourceFileInfo: SourceFileInfo | null;
  author: unknown = null;
  moderators: unknown[] = [];
  summary: string | null = null;
  details: string | null = null;
  alertLevel = 0;
  flags: string[] = [];
  timeSheetRecord: unknown = null;

  constructor(
    journal: Journal,
    date: TjTime,
    headline: string,
    property: PropertyTreeNode | null,
    sourceFileInfo: SourceFileInfo | null = null,
  ) {
    this.journal = journal;
    this.date = date;
    this.headline = headline;
    this.property = property;
    this.sourceFileInfo = sourceFileInfo;
    // Adiciona a nova entrada ao journal (Ruby Journal.rb:61).
    journal.addEntry(this,);
  }
}

export class Journal {
  readonly entries: JournalEntry[] = [];

  addEntry(entry: JournalEntry,): void {
    this.entries.push(entry,);
  }

  /** Entradas da propriedade (ou globais quando `property` é null). */
  entriesFor(property: PropertyTreeNode | null,): JournalEntry[] {
    return this.entries.filter((e,) => e.property === property);
  }

  get empty(): boolean {
    return this.entries.length === 0;
  }
}
```

## File: `packages/core/src/model/material-allocation.ts`

```ts
import { Material, } from "./material.ts";

/**
 * Modificador de alocação de material — define como uma quantidade de material
 * é distribuída no tempo durante a execução de uma tarefa.
 *
 * @see docs/syntaxmesh/fases/fase-8.1-nova-funcionalidade-custos.md
 */
export type MaterialAllocationModifier =
  | "onstart"
  | "onend"
  | "perhour"
  | "perday"
  | "perweek"
  | "permonth"
  | "distributed"
  | "distribution";

/**
 * Representa uma alocação de material a uma tarefa, com um modificador
 * temporal que determina quando e como o material é consumido.
 */
export class MaterialAllocation {
  readonly material: Material;
  readonly quantity: number;
  readonly modifier: MaterialAllocationModifier;
  readonly distribution?: number[];

  constructor(
    material: Material,
    quantity: number,
    modifier: MaterialAllocationModifier,
    distribution?: number[],
  ) {
    this.material = material;
    this.quantity = quantity;
    this.modifier = modifier;
    this.distribution = distribution;

    // Validação
    if (quantity < 0) {
      throw new Error("Material allocation quantity cannot be negative");
    }

    if (distribution) {
      const sum = distribution.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);
      if (Math.abs(sum - 1.0) > 0.001) {
        throw new Error(
          `Material allocation distribution must sum to 1.0, got ${sum}`,
        );
      }
    }
  }

  /**
   * Cópia profunda imutável.
   * Retorna this (imutável) para compatibilidade com deepClone.
   */
  deepClone(): this {
    return this;
  }
}

```

## File: `packages/core/src/model/material.ts`

```ts
import { PropertyTreeNode, } from "./property-tree-node.ts";
import { type ProjectLike, } from "./project-like.ts";
import { PropertySet, } from "./property-set.ts";
import { ChargeSetCollection, } from "../finance/charge-set-collection.ts";

/**
 * Entidade de primeira classe representando um insumo físico do projeto
 * (aço, concreto, tinta etc.), com quantidade, preço unitário e
 * distribuição temporal.
 *
 * @see docs/syntaxmesh/fases/fase-8.1-nova-funcionalidade-custos.md
 */
export class Material extends PropertyTreeNode {
  readonly unit: string;
  readonly unitPrice: number;
  readonly chargeset: ChargeSetCollection;
  readonly totalQuantity?: number;

  constructor(
    project: ProjectLike,
    id: string,
    unit: string,
    unitPrice: number,
    chargeset?: ChargeSetCollection,
    totalQuantity?: number,
  ) {
    // Material não é registrado em PropertySet — é uma entidade simples.
    // Usamos um PropertySet temporário apenas para satisfazer o construtor.
    const propertySet = new PropertySet(project, false);
    super(propertySet, id, id, null,);
    this.unit = unit;
    this.unitPrice = unitPrice;
    this.chargeset = chargeset ?? new ChargeSetCollection();
    this.totalQuantity = totalQuantity;
  }

  /**
   * Custo total do material (quantidade × preço unitário).
   */
  totalCost(): number {
    const quantity = this.totalQuantity ?? 0;
    return quantity * this.unitPrice;
  }

  /**
   * Cópia profunda imutável.
   * Retorna this (imutável) para compatibilidade com deepClone.
   */
  deepClone(): this {
    return this;
  }
}

```

```ts
    if (this.tasks.items === 0) {

    for (const sc of this.scenarios.toArray()) {

      if (!sc.get("active",)) continue;

      const scIdx = this.scenarioIdx(sc,)!;

      // propagate inherited values. These values must be marked as
      // inherited by setting the mode to 1. As we always call
      // PropertyTreeNode#inherit this is just a safeguard.
      AttributeBase.setMode(1,);
      this.prepareScenario(scIdx,);

      // Now change to mode 2 so all values that are modified are marked
      // as computed.
      AttributeBase.setMode(2,);
      // Schedule the scenario.
      this.scheduleScenario(scIdx,);

      // Complete the data sets, and check the result.
      this.finishScenario(scIdx,);
    }

    // Check for failed tasks and resources after all scenarios are scheduled
    // Ruby: resources.each { resource.checkFailsAndWarnings } (once per resource)

    for (const resource of this.resources.toArray()) {

    const start = this.get("start",) as TjTime;
    const end = this.get("end",) as TjTime;
    const granularity = this.get("scheduleGranularity",) as number;
    this.scoreboard = new Scoreboard(
      start.toDate(),
      end.toDate(),
      granularity,
      2,
    );
    // And the same for another scoreboard.
    this.scoreboardNoLeaves = new Scoreboard(
      start.toDate(),
      end.toDate(),
      granularity,
      2,
    );

    const workinghours = this.get("workinghours",) as unknown;

    // Change all work time slots to nil (available) again.
    let date = this.scoreboard.idxToDate(0,);
    const delta = this.get("scheduleGranularity",) as number;
    const scoreboardSize = this.scoreboardSize();
    for (let i = 0; i < scoreboardSize; i++) {
      if (
        workinghours &&
        (workinghours as { onShift?: (arg: TjTime | number,) => boolean })
          .onShift?.(
            TjTime.fromDate(date,),
          )
      ) {
        this.scoreboard.set(i, null,);
        this.scoreboardNoLeaves.set(i, null,);
      }
      date = new Date(date.getTime() + delta * 1000,);
    }

    // Mark all global leave slots as such
    const leaves = this.get("leaves",) as unknown;
    if (leaves) {
      for (
        const leave of leaves as { interval: { start: TjTime; end: TjTime } }[]
      ) {
        const startIdx = this.scoreboard.dateToIdx(
          leave.interval.start.toDate(),
        );
        const endIdx = this.scoreboard.dateToIdx(leave.interval.end.toDate(),);
        for (let i = startIdx; i < endIdx; i++) {
          // If the slot is nil or set to 4 then don't set the time-off bit.
          const sb = this.scoreboard.get(i,);
          this.scoreboard.set(
            i,
            ((sb === null || sb === 4) ? 0 : 2) | (1 << 2),
          );
        }
      }
    }
  }

  private computeResourceAvailabilities(
    scIdx: number,
    usedResources: Resource[],
  ): void {
    const start = this.get("start",) as TjTime;
    const end = this.get("end",) as TjTime;
    const granularity = this.get("scheduleGranularity",) as number;
    this.resourceAvailability = new Scoreboard(
      start.toDate(),
      end.toDate(),
      granularity,
    );

    const scoreboardSize = this.scoreboardSize();
    for (let idx = 0; idx < scoreboardSize; idx++) {
      for (const resource of usedResources) {
        if (resource.scenarioData(scIdx,).available(idx,)) {
          this.resourceAvailability.set(idx, true,);
          break;
        }
      }
    }
  }

  private prepareScenario(scIdx: number,): void {
    const resources = new PropertyList(this.resources,);
    const tasks = new PropertyList(this.tasks,);

    // Compile a list of leaf resources that are actually used in this
    // project.
    const usedResources: Resource[] = [];
    for (const task of tasks.toArray()) {
      for (
        const resource of (task.scenarioData(scIdx,) as TaskScenario)
          .candidates()
      ) {
        if (!usedResources.includes(resource,)) {
          usedResources.push(resource,);
        }
      }
    }
    const total = usedResources.length;
    let i = 0;
    for (const resource of usedResources) {
      (resource.scenarioData(scIdx,) as ResourceScenario).prepareScheduling();
      (resource.scenarioData(scIdx,) as ResourceScenario).preScheduleCheck();
      i++;
    }

    for (const resource of resources.toArray()) {
      (resource.scenarioData(scIdx,) as ResourceScenario).setDirectReports();
    }
    for (const resource of resources.toArray()) {
      (resource.scenarioData(scIdx,) as ResourceScenario).setReports();
    }

    this.computeResourceAvailabilities(scIdx, usedResources,);

    for (const task of tasks.toArray()) {
      (task.scenarioData(scIdx,) as TaskScenario).prepareScheduling();
    }
    for (const task of tasks.toArray()) {
      (task.scenarioData(scIdx,) as TaskScenario).Xref();
    }
    for (const task of tasks.toArray()) {
      (task.scenarioData(scIdx,) as TaskScenario).propagateInitialValues();
    }
    for (const task of tasks.toArray()) {
      (task.scenarioData(scIdx,) as TaskScenario).preScheduleCheck();
    }

    // Check for dependency loops in the task graph.
    for (const task of tasks.toArray()) {
      (task.scenarioData(scIdx,) as TaskScenario).resetLoopFlags();
    }
    for (const task of tasks.toArray()) {
      if (task.parent === null) {
        (task.scenarioData(scIdx,) as TaskScenario).checkForLoops(
          [],
          false,
          true,
          true,
        );
      }
    }
    for (const task of tasks.toArray()) {
      (task.scenarioData(scIdx,) as TaskScenario).resetLoopFlags();
    }
    for (const task of tasks.toArray()) {
      if (task.parent === null) {
        (task.scenarioData(scIdx,) as TaskScenario).checkForLoops(
          [],
          true,
          true,
          false,
        );
      }
    }

    // Compute the criticalness of the tasks and their pathes.
    for (const task of tasks.toArray()) {
      (task.scenarioData(scIdx,) as TaskScenario).countResourceAllocations();
    }
    for (const resource of resources.toArray()) {
      (resource.scenarioData(scIdx,) as ResourceScenario).calcCriticalness();
    }
    for (const task of tasks.toArray()) {
      (task.scenarioData(scIdx,) as TaskScenario).calcCriticalness();
    }
    for (const task of tasks.toArray()) {
      (task.scenarioData(scIdx,) as TaskScenario).calcPathCriticalness();
    }
    this.timeSheets.check();
  }

  private scheduleScenario(scIdx: number,): boolean {
    const tasks = new PropertyList(this.tasks,);
    // Only care about leaf tasks that are not milestones and aren't
    // scheduled already (marked with the 'scheduled' attribute).
    tasks.deleteIf((task,) =>
      !task.leaf() ||
      Boolean((task.scenarioData(scIdx,) as TaskScenario).a("milestone",),) ||
      Boolean((task.scenarioData(scIdx,) as TaskScenario).a("scheduled",),)
    );

    // The sorting of the work item list determines which tasks will get their
    // resources first. The first sorting criterium is the user specified task
    // priority. The second criterium is the scheduler determined priority
    // stored in the pathcriticalness attribute. That way, the user can always
    // override the scheduler determined priority. To always have a defined
    // order, the third criterium is the sequence number.
    tasks.setSorting([["priority", false, scIdx,], [
      "pathcriticalness",
      false,
      scIdx,
    ], ["seqno", true, -1,],],);
    tasks.sort();
    const totalTasks = tasks.length();

    // Enter the main scheduling loop. This loop is only terminated when all
    // tasks have been scheduled or another thread has set the breakFlag to
    // true.
    const failedTasks: unknown[] = [];
    while (tasks.length() > 0) {
      // Now find the task with the highest priority that can be scheduled
      // and schedule it.
      let taskToRemove = null;
      for (const task of tasks.toArray()) {
        // Task not ready? Ignore it.
        if (!(task.scenarioData(scIdx,) as TaskScenario).readyForScheduling()) {
          continue;
        }

        if (!(task.scenarioData(scIdx,) as TaskScenario).schedule()) {
          failedTasks.push(task,);
        }
        // The task has been completed or failed. But we can remove it from
        // the todo list.
        taskToRemove = task;
        // The scheduling of this task may cause other higher priority tasks
        // to be ready now. So we terminate the inner loop and start at the
        // top of the list again.
        break;
      }

      // There should always be a task to be removed. If not, the scheduler
      // has found a set of tasks that deadlock each other.
      if (taskToRemove) {
        const taskIndex = tasks.itemIndex(taskToRemove,);
        tasks.delete(taskIndex,);
      } else if (failedTasks.length === 0) {
        // We have some tasks that cannot be scheduled.
        break;
      }
    }

    // Check for failed tasks and report the first 10 of them as
    // warnings.
    if (failedTasks.length > 0) {
      // warning('unscheduled_tasks', "#{failedTasks.length} tasks could not be scheduled")
      // i = 0
      // failedTasks.each do |t|
      //   warning('unscheduled_task',
      //           "Task #{t.fullId}: " +
      //           "#{t['start', scIdx] ? t['start', scIdx] : '<?>'} -> " +
      //           "#{t['end', scIdx] ? t['end', scIdx] : '<?>'}",
      //           t.sourceFileInfo)

      //   i += 1
      //   break if i >= 10
      // end
      // Log.stopProgressMeter
      // return false
      return false;
    }

    // Log.stopProgressMeter
    // Log.exit('scheduleScenario', "Scheduling of scenario #{scIdx} finished")
    return true;
  }

  private finishScenario(scIdx: number,): void {
    for (const task of this.tasks.toArray()) {
      // Recursively traverse the top-level tasks to finish all tasks.
      if (task.parent === null) {
        (task.scenarioData(scIdx,) as TaskScenario).finishScheduling();
      }
    }

    for (const resource of this.resources.toArray()) {
      // Recursively traverse the top-level resources to finish them all.
      if (resource.parent === null) {
        (resource.scenarioData(scIdx,) as ResourceScenario).finishScheduling();
      }
    }

    let i = 0;
    const total = this.tasks.items;
    for (const task of this.tasks.toArray()) {
      if (task.parent === null) {
        (task.scenarioData(scIdx,) as TaskScenario).postScheduleCheck();
      }
      i++;
    }
  }
}
```

```ts
/**
 * Interface mínima para o que `AttributeBase` precisa saber sobre
 * a propriedade que o contém.
 *
 * Na Fase 3, só temos `id` e `name`. A Fase 4 (PropertyTreeNode)
 * expande esta interface (adiciona `project`, `children`, `parent`, etc.).
 *
 * Esta interface evita que a Fase 3 importe `PropertyTreeNode` (que só
 * existe na Fase 4). Quando a Fase 4 chegar, `PropertyTreeNode implements
 * PropertyLike` sem quebrar nada.
 */
export interface PropertyLike {
  /** ID completo da propriedade (ex: "proj.task1.subtask2"). */
  readonly id: string;

  /** Nome amigável da propriedade. */
  readonly name: string;
}
```

```ts
import { PropertyTreeNode, } from "./property-tree-node.ts";
import { PropertySet, } from "./property-set.ts";
import { SourceFileInfo, } from "../source-file-info.ts";

export class PropertyList<T extends PropertyTreeNode = PropertyTreeNode,> {
  private items: T[];
  readonly propertySet: PropertySet;
  private sortingLevels: number;
  private sortingCriteria: string[];
  private sortingUp: boolean[];
  private scenarioIdx: number[];

  constructor(arg: PropertySet | PropertyList<T>, copyItems: boolean = true,) {
    if (arg instanceof PropertySet) {
      this.propertySet = arg;
      this.items = [];
    } else {
      this.propertySet = arg.propertySet;
      this.items = copyItems ? [...arg.items,] : arg.items;
    }
    this.sortingLevels = 0;
    this.sortingCriteria = [];
    this.sortingUp = [];
    this.scenarioIdx = [];
  }

  toArray(): T[] {
    return [...this.items,];
  }

  length(): number {
    return this.items.length;
  }

  get(index: number,): T | undefined {
    return this.items[index];
  }

  [Symbol.iterator](): Iterator<T> {
    return this.items[Symbol.iterator]();
  }

  includes(node: T,): boolean {
    return this.items.includes(node,);
  }

  find(predicateOrNode: ((item: T,) => boolean) | T,): T | null {
    if (typeof predicateOrNode === "function") {
      return this.items.find(predicateOrNode as (item: T,) => boolean,) ?? null;
    }
    const index = this.items.indexOf(predicateOrNode,);
    return index >= 0 ? this.items[index] ?? null : null;
  }

  push(...items: T[]): number {
    return this.items.push(...items,);
  }

  append(list: PropertyList<T> | T[],): void {
    if (list instanceof PropertyList) {
      this.items.push(...list.items,);
    } else {
      this.items.push(...list,);
    }
  }

  delete(index: number,): void {
    if (index >= 0 && index < this.items.length) {
      this.items.splice(index, 1,);
    }
  }

  deleteIf(predicate: (item: T,) => boolean,): void {
    const indices = this.items
      .map((item, index,) => ({ item, index, }))
      .filter(({ item, },) => predicate(item,))
      .map(({ index, },) => index)
      .sort((a, b,) => b - a);

    indices.forEach((index,) => {
      this.items.splice(index, 1,);
    },);
  }

  unique(): void {
    const seen = new Set<string>();
    this.items = this.items.filter((item,) => {
      const id = item.id;
      if (seen.has(id,)) {
        return false;
      }
      seen.add(id,);
      return true;
    },);
  }

  clear(): void {
    this.items = [];
  }

  includeAdopted(): void {
    const allItems: T[] = [];
    this.items.forEach((item,) => {
      allItems.push(item,);
      allItems.push(...(item.adoptees as unknown as T[]),);
    },);
    this.items = allItems;
  }

  checkForDuplicates(sfi: SourceFileInfo,): void {
    const seen = new Set<string>();
    this.items.forEach((item,) => {
      if (seen.has(item.id,)) {
        throw new Error(`Duplicate property ID: ${item.id}`,);
      }
      seen.add(item.id,);
    },);
  }

  setSorting(modes: Array<[string, boolean, number,]>,): void {
    this.sortingCriteria = [];
    this.sortingUp = [];
    this.scenarioIdx = [];

    modes.forEach(([criteria, up, scIdx,],) => {
      this.addSortingCriteria(criteria, up, scIdx,);
    },);
  }

  addSortingCriteria(criteria: string, up: boolean, scIdx: number,): void {
    if (
      !this.propertySet.knownAttribute(criteria,) &&
      !this.hasQuery(criteria, scIdx,)
    ) {
      throw new Error(`Unknown attribute or query: ${criteria}`,);
    }

    if (this.scenarioSpecific(criteria, scIdx,) && scIdx === -1) {
      throw new Error(`Scenario-specific attribute requires scenario index`,);
    }

    this.sortingCriteria.push(criteria,);
    this.sortingUp.push(up,);
    this.scenarioIdx.push(scIdx,);
    this.sortingLevels++;
  }

  resetSorting(): void {
    this.sortingCriteria = [];
    this.sortingUp = [];
    this.scenarioIdx = [];
    this.sortingLevels = 0;
  }

  treeMode(): boolean {
    return this.sortingCriteria.length > 0 &&
      this.sortingCriteria[0] === "tree";
  }

  sort(): void {
    if (this.treeMode()) {
      this.sortTreeMode();
    } else {
      this.sortInternal();
    }
  }

  private sortTreeMode(): void {
    if (this.sortingLevels > 1) {
      this.removeFirstCriteria();
      this.sortInternal();
      this.index();
      this.indexTree();
      this.addFirstCriteria();
      this.sortInternal();
    } else {
      this.sortInternal();
    }
  }

  private removeFirstCriteria(): void {
    if (this.sortingCriteria.length > 0) {
      this.sortingCriteria.shift();
      this.sortingUp.shift();
      this.scenarioIdx.shift();
      this.sortingLevels--;
    }
  }

  private addFirstCriteria(): void {
    if (this.sortingCriteria.length === 0) {
      this.sortingCriteria.unshift("tree",);
      this.sortingUp.unshift(true,);
      this.scenarioIdx.unshift(-1,);
      this.sortingLevels++;
    }
  }

  private sortInternal(): void {
    this.items.sort((a, b,) => {
      for (let i = 0; i < this.sortingCriteria.length; i++) {
        const criteria = this.sortingCriteria[i]!;
        const up = this.sortingUp[i];
        const scIdx = this.scenarioIdx[i];

        let aValue: unknown, bValue: unknown;

        if (this.scenarioSpecific(criteria, scIdx!,)) {
          aValue = a.getForScenario(criteria, scIdx!,);
          bValue = b.getForScenario(criteria, scIdx!,);
        } else {
          aValue = a.get(criteria,);
          bValue = b.get(criteria,);
        }

        if (aValue === bValue) {
          continue;
        }

        if (aValue === null || aValue === undefined) {
          return up ? 1 : -1;
        }
        if (bValue === null || bValue === undefined) {
          return up ? -1 : 1;
        }

        if (typeof aValue === "string" && typeof bValue === "string") {
          const comparison = aValue.localeCompare(bValue,);
          return up ? comparison : -comparison;
        }

        if (typeof aValue === "number" && typeof bValue === "number") {
          return up ? aValue - bValue : bValue - aValue;
        }

        const aStr = String(aValue,);
        const bStr = String(bValue,);
        const comparison = aStr.localeCompare(bStr,);
        return up ? comparison : -comparison;
      }

      return 0;
    },);
  }

  index(): void {
    this.items.forEach((item, index,) => {
      item.set("index", index + 1,);
    },);
  }

  private indexTree(): void {
    this.items.forEach((item, index,) => {
      const bsIdcs = item.getBSIndicies();
      let bsi = "";
      let first = true;
      bsIdcs.forEach((idx,) => {
        if (first) {
          first = false;
        } else {
          bsi += ".";
        }
        bsi += idx.toString();
      },);
      item.force("bsi", bsi,);
    },);
  }

  itemIndex(item: T,): number {
    return this.items.indexOf(item,);
  }

  private hasQuery(criteria: string, scIdx: number,): boolean {
    return false;
  }

  private scenarioSpecific(criteria: string, scIdx: number,): boolean {
    return this.propertySet.scenarioSpecific?.(criteria,) || false;
  }
}
```

```ts
import { type ProjectLike, } from "./project-like.ts";
import { type PropertyTreeNode, } from "./property-tree-node.ts";
import { AttributeDefinition, } from "../attributes/attribute-definition.ts";
import { AttributeType, } from "../attributes/attribute-type.ts";
import { TjArgumentError, } from "../attributes/errors.ts";
import { ScenarioData, } from "./scenario-data.ts";

export class PropertySet {
  readonly _project: ProjectLike;
  readonly _flatNamespace: boolean;
  private _properties: PropertyTreeNode[];
  private _propertyMap: Map<string, PropertyTreeNode>;
  private _attributeDefinitions: Map<string, AttributeDefinition<unknown>>;

  constructor(project: ProjectLike, flatNamespace: boolean,) {
    if (project === null || project === undefined) {
      throw new TjArgumentError("project parameter may not be NIL",);
    }
    this._project = project;
    this._flatNamespace = flatNamespace;
    this._properties = [];
    this._propertyMap = new Map();
    this._attributeDefinitions = new Map();

    // Add base attributes
    this.addAttributeType(
      new AttributeDefinition(
        "id",
        "ID",
        AttributeType.String,
        "",
        false,
        false,
        false,
        false,
      ),
    );
    this.addAttributeType(
      new AttributeDefinition(
        "name",
        "Name",
        AttributeType.String,
        "",
        false,
        false,
        false,
        false,
      ),
    );
    this.addAttributeType(
      new AttributeDefinition(
        "seqno",
        "Seq. No",
        AttributeType.Integer,
        0,
        false,
        false,
        false,
        false,
      ),
    );
  }

  get project(): ProjectLike {
    return this._project;
  }

  get flatNamespace(): boolean {
    return this._flatNamespace;
  }

  get items(): number {
    return this._properties.length;
  }

  addAttributeType(attrDef: AttributeDefinition<unknown>,): void {
    if (this._properties.length > 0) {
      throw new TjArgumentError(
        "Attribute types must be defined before properties are added.",
      );
    }
    this._attributeDefinitions.set(attrDef.id, attrDef,);
  }

  eachAttributeDefinition(
    callback?: (attrDef: AttributeDefinition<unknown>,) => void,
  ): void | IterableIterator<AttributeDefinition<unknown>> {
    if (callback) {
      this._attributeDefinitions.forEach((value,) => callback(value,));
      return;
    }
    return this._attributeDefinitions.values()[Symbol.iterator]();
  }

  knownAttribute(id: string,): boolean {
    return this._attributeDefinitions.has(id,);
  }

  scenarioSpecific?(id: string,): boolean {
    if (this._attributeDefinitions.has(id,)) {
      return this._attributeDefinitions.get(id,)!.isScenarioAttribute;
    } else if (this._properties.length > 0) {
      const property = this._properties[0]!;
      if (
        property.data[0] &&
        property.data[0].a("query_" + id,) !== undefined
      ) {
        return true;
      }
    }
    return false;
  }

  inheritedFromProject?(id: string,): boolean {
    if (!this._attributeDefinitions.has(id,)) {
      return false;
    }
    return this._attributeDefinitions.get(id,)!.inheritedFromProject;
  }

  inheritedFromParent?(id: string,): boolean {
    if (!this._attributeDefinitions.has(id,)) {
      return false;
    }
    return this._attributeDefinitions.get(id,)!.inheritedFromParent;
  }

  userDefined?(id: string,): boolean {
    if (!this._attributeDefinitions.has(id,)) {
      return false;
    }
    return this._attributeDefinitions.get(id,)!.userDefined;
  }

  listAttribute?(id: string,): boolean {
    const ad = this._attributeDefinitions.get(id,);
    return ad !== undefined && ad.isList;
  }

  defaultValue(id: string,): unknown {
    const ad = this._attributeDefinitions.get(id,);
    return ad !== undefined ? ad.defaultValue : undefined;
  }

  attributeName(id: string,): string | undefined {
    const ad = this._attributeDefinitions.get(id,);
    return ad !== undefined ? ad.name : undefined;
  }

  attributeType(id: string,): AttributeType | undefined {
    const ad = this._attributeDefinitions.get(id,);
    return ad !== undefined ? ad.type : undefined;
  }

  addProperty(prop: PropertyTreeNode,): void {
    this._propertyMap.set(prop.id, prop,);
    this._properties.push(prop,);
    
    // Resize data and scenarioAttributes arrays for the added property
    // to match the current project scenarioCount
    const scenarioCount = this._project.scenarioCount;
    if (scenarioCount > 0) {
      // Ensure data array has correct length
      if (prop.data.length !== scenarioCount) {
        const newData = Array.from(
          { length: scenarioCount },
          (_, i,) => prop.data[i] ?? new ScenarioData(prop, i, new Map(),),
        );
        prop.data = newData;
      }
      
      // Ensure scenarioAttributes array has correct length
      if (prop.scenarioAttributes.length !== scenarioCount) {
        const newScenarioAttributes = Array.from(
          { length: scenarioCount },
          (_, i,) => prop.scenarioAttributes[i] ?? new Map(),
        );
        prop.scenarioAttributes = newScenarioAttributes;
      }
    }
  }

  removeProperty(prop: PropertyTreeNode | string,): PropertyTreeNode {
    let property: PropertyTreeNode;
    if (typeof prop === "string") {
      property = this._propertyMap.get(prop,)!;
    } else {
      property = prop;
    }

    this._properties.forEach((p,) => {
      p.removeReferences(property,);
    },);

    while (property.children.length > 0) {
      const child = property.children[0];
      if (child) {
        this.removeProperty(child,);
      } else {
        break;
      }
    }

    this._properties = this._properties.filter((p,) => p !== property);
    this._propertyMap.delete(property.id,);

    const parent = property.parents()[0];
    if (parent) {
      const idx = parent.children.indexOf(property,);
      if (idx !== -1) {
        parent.children.splice(idx, 1,);
      }
    }

    return property;
  }

  clearProperties(): void {
    this._properties = [];
    this._propertyMap.clear();
  }

  get(id: string,): PropertyTreeNode | undefined {
    return this._propertyMap.get(id,);
  }

  index(): void {
    this._properties.forEach((p,) => {
      const bsIdcs = p.getBSIndicies();
      let bsi = "";
      let first = true;
      bsIdcs.forEach((idx,) => {
        if (first) {
          first = false;
        } else {
          bsi += ".";
        }
        bsi += idx.toString();
      },);
      p.force("bsi", bsi,);
    },);
  }

  levelSeqNo(property: PropertyTreeNode,): number {
    let seqNo = 1;
    for (const p of this._properties) {
      if (!p.parent) {
        if (p === property) {
          return seqNo;
        }
        seqNo++;
      }
    }
    throw new Error("Fatal Error: Unknown property " + property.id,);
  }

  maxDepth(): number {
    let md = 0;
    this._properties.forEach((p,) => {
      if (p.level > md) {
        md = p.level;
      }

    return md + 1;
```

```ts
import { type PropertyTreeNode, } from "./property-tree-node.ts";
import { type ProjectLike, } from "./project-like.ts";

import { ScenarioData, } from "./scenario-data.ts";

export class PTNProxy implements AttributeContainer {
  private readonly _ptn: PropertyTreeNode;
  private readonly parent: PropertyTreeNode;
  private readonly index: number;
  private readonly tree: PropertyTreeNode;
  private readonly levelCache: number;

  constructor(ptn: PropertyTreeNode, parent: PropertyTreeNode,) {
    this._ptn = ptn;
    this.parent = parent;
    this.index = parent.children.indexOf(ptn,);
    this.tree = this.findTreeRoot(ptn, parent,);
    this.levelCache = this.calculateLevel();
  }

  private findTreeRoot(
    ptn: PropertyTreeNode,
    parent: PropertyTreeNode,
  ): PropertyTreeNode {
    let current: PropertyTreeNode = ptn;
    while (current.parents()[0]) {
      current = current.parents()[0] as PropertyTreeNode;
    }
    return current;
  }

  private calculateLevel(): number {
    let level = 1;
    let current: PropertyTreeNode | null = this.parent;
    while (current) {
      level++;
      current = current.parents()[0] as PropertyTreeNode | null;
    }
    return level;
  }

  logicalId(): string {
    if (this._ptn.propertySet.flatNamespace) {
      return this._ptn.id;
    }
    let result = this._ptn.subId;
    let current: PropertyTreeNode | null = this.parent;
    while (current) {
      result = current.subId + "." + result;
      current = current.parents()[0] as PropertyTreeNode | null;
    }
    return result;
  }

  get(attribute: string,): unknown {
    if (this.index >= 0 && this.tree.children[this.index] === this._ptn) {
      return this._ptn.get(attribute,);
    }
    return undefined;
  }

  set(attribute: string, value: unknown,): void {
    if (this.index >= 0 && this.tree.children[this.index] === this._ptn) {
      this._ptn.set(attribute, value,);
    }
  }

  getForScenario(attribute: string, scIdx: number,): unknown {
    if (this.index >= 0 && this.tree.children[this.index] === this._ptn) {
      return this._ptn.getForScenario(attribute, scIdx,);
    }
    return undefined;
  }

  setForScenario(attribute: string, value: unknown, scIdx: number,): void {
    if (this.index >= 0 && this.tree.children[this.index] === this._ptn) {
      this._ptn.setForScenario(attribute, value, scIdx,);
    }
  }

  get level(): number {
    return this.levelCache;
  }

  isChildOf(ancestor: PropertyTreeNode,): boolean {
    let current: PropertyTreeNode | null = this.parent;
    while (current) {
      if (current === ancestor) {
        return true;
      }
      current = current.parents()[0] as PropertyTreeNode | null;
    }

  }

  getIndicies(): number[] {
    const indices: number[] = [];
    let current: PropertyTreeNode | null = this._ptn;
    while (current) {

      if (parent && parent.propertySet.knownAttribute("index",)) {

        if (index !== null && index !== undefined && index !== 0) {

  setStoredValue(attributeId: string, value: unknown,): void {
```

```ts
        const endIdx = this.scoreboard!.dateToIdx(leave.interval.end.toDate(),);
        for (let i = startIdx; i < endIdx; i++) {
          const sb = this.scoreboard!.get(i,);
          if (sb !== null && typeof sb === "number") {
            // The slot is already marked as non-working slot. Override leave type
            // if the new type is larger than the old one.
            const leaveIdx = (sb & 0x3C) >> 2;
            if (leave.typeIdx > leaveIdx) {
              this.scoreboard!.set(i, (sb & 0x2) | (leave.typeIdx << 2),);
            }
          } else {
            // Mark a working time slot as a leave slot.
            this.scoreboard!.set(i, leave.typeIdx << 2,);
          }
        }
      }
    }

    // Apply shift leaves
    const shifts = this.a("shifts",) as ShiftAssignments | undefined;
    if (shifts) {
      for (let i = 0; i < size; i++) {
        const v = shifts.getSbSlot(i,);
        if (!v) continue;

        if ((v & (1 << 8)) !== 0) {
          // Override bit set: copy whole interval to resource scoreboard
          this.scoreboard!.set(i, (v & 0x3E) === 0 ? null : (v & 0x3D),);
        } else if (
          (this.scoreboard!.get(i,) === null ||
            ((this.scoreboard!.get(i,) as number & 0x3C) < (v & 0x3C))) &&
          (v & 0x3C) !== 0
        ) {
          // Merge mode: add shift leaves with higher type index or unassigned slots
          this.scoreboard!.set(i, v & 0x3E,);
        }
      }
    }

    // Set minimum and maximum availability
    let idx = 0;
    while (idx < this.scoreboard.size) {
      if (this.available(idx,)) {
        this.minslot = idx;
        break;
      }
      idx++;
    }
    idx = this.scoreboard.size - 1;
    while (idx >= 0) {
      if (this.available(idx,)) {
        this.maxslot = idx;
        break;
      }
      idx--;
    }
  }

  /**
   * Generic slot counter for the scoreboard.
   */
  private countSlots(
    startIdx: number,
    endIdx: number,
    predicate: (val: number | null | Task,) => boolean,
  ): number {
    if (startIdx >= endIdx) return 0;
    if (this.scoreboard === null) {
      this.initScoreboard();
    }
    let slots = 0;
    for (let i = startIdx; i < endIdx; i++) {
      if (predicate(this.scoreboard!.get(i,),)) {
        slots++;
      }
    }
    return slots;
  }

  /**
   * Count booked slots between startIdx and endIdx. If task is provided,
   * only count slots assigned to that task or its sub-tasks.
   */
  getAllocatedSlots(
    startIdx: number,
    endIdx: number,
    task: Task | null = null,
  ): number {
    if (this.scoreboard === null) return 0;

    [startIdx, endIdx,] = this.fitIndicies(startIdx, endIdx, task,);
    if (startIdx >= endIdx) return 0;

    const taskList = task ? task.all() : [];
    return this.countSlots(startIdx, endIdx, (slot,) => {
      if (!(slot instanceof Task)) return false;
      return task === null || taskList.includes(slot,);
    },);
  }

  /**
   * Count free slots between startIdx and endIdx.
   */
  getFreeSlots(startIdx: number, endIdx: number,): number {
    return this.countSlots(startIdx, endIdx, (val,) => val === null,);
  }

  /**
   * Count leave slots of a specific type between startIdx and endIdx.
   */
  getLeaveSlots(
    startIdx: number,
    endIdx: number,
    type: number | string,
  ): number {
    const leaveType = typeof type === "string" ? LEAVE_TYPES[type]! : type;
    return this.countSlots(
      startIdx,
      endIdx,
      (val,) => typeof val === "number" && (val & 0x3E) === (leaveType << 2),
    );
  }

  /**
   * Count time-off slots (working time blocked by leaves) between startIdx and endIdx.
   */
  getTimeOffSlots(startIdx: number, endIdx: number,): number {
    return this.countSlots(
      startIdx,
      endIdx,
      (val,) =>
        typeof val === "number" && (val & 0x2) === 0 && (val & 0x3C) !== 0,
    );
  }

  /**
   * Limit the startIdx and endIdx to the actually assigned interval.
   * If task is provided, fit it for the bookings of this particular task.
   */
  private fitIndicies(
    startIdx: number,
    endIdx: number,
    task: Task | null = null,
  ): [number, number,] {
    if (task) {
      const taskFirst = this.firstBookedSlots.get(task,);
      if (taskFirst !== undefined && startIdx < taskFirst) {
        startIdx = taskFirst;
      }
      const taskLast = this.lastBookedSlots.get(task,);
      if (taskLast !== undefined && endIdx > taskLast + 1) {
        endIdx = taskLast + 1;
      }
    } else {
      if (this.firstBookedSlot !== null && startIdx < this.firstBookedSlot) {
        startIdx = this.firstBookedSlot;
      }
      if (this.lastBookedSlot !== null && endIdx > this.lastBookedSlot + 1) {
        endIdx = this.lastBookedSlot + 1;
      }
    }
    return [startIdx, endIdx,];
  }

  /**
   * Generic tree iterator that recursively accumulates the result of the
   * block for each leaf object.
   */
  private treeSum<T,>(
    startIdx: number,
    endIdx: number,
    arg: T,
    block: () => number,
  ): number {
    const cacheTag = `ResourceScenario#treeSum`;
    return this.treeSumR(cacheTag, startIdx, endIdx, arg, block,);
  }

  private treeSumR<T,>(
    cacheTag: string,
    startIdx: number,
    endIdx: number,
    arg: T,
    block: () => number,
  ): number {
    if ((this.getProperty() as PropertyTreeNode).container?.()) {
      let sum = 0.0;
      for (const child of (this.getProperty() as PropertyTreeNode).kids()) {
        sum += (child as Resource).scenarioData(this.getScenarioIdx(),)
          .treeSumR(
            cacheTag,
            startIdx,
            endIdx,
            arg,
            block,
          );
      }
      return sum;
    } else {
      return block();
    }
  }

  /**
   * Returns true if the resource is on shift at the time specified by
   * _sbIdx_.
   *
   * If shifts are assigned to this resource and the slot is assigned,
   * the shift's availability is checked. Otherwise, the working hours
   * are used to determine availability.
   */
  private onShiftCheck(sbIdx: number,): boolean {
    const shifts = this.a("shifts",) as ShiftAssignments | undefined;
    if (shifts && shifts.assigned(sbIdx,)) {
      return shifts.onShift(sbIdx,);
    }
    const workinghours = this.a("workinghours",) as WorkingHours | undefined;
    if (workinghours) {
      return workinghours.onShift(sbIdx,);
    }
    return true;
  }

  /**
   * Returns true if the resource is employed at the given slot.
   */
  private employed(sbIdx: number,): boolean {
    if (this.scoreboard === null) {
      this.initScoreboard();
    }
    const val = this.scoreboard!.get(sbIdx,);
    if (typeof val !== "number") return true;

    const leaveType = (val >> 2) & 0xF;
    const unemployedType = LEAVE_TYPES["unemployed"];
    if (unemployedType === undefined) return true;
    return leaveType < unemployedType;
  }

  /**
   * Returns the daily cost/rate of a resource or resource group.
   */
  rate(): number {
    if ((this.getProperty() as PropertyTreeNode).container?.()) {
      let dailyRate = 0.0;
      for (const child of (this.getProperty() as PropertyTreeNode).kids()) {
        dailyRate += (child as Resource).scenarioData(this.getScenarioIdx(),)
          .rate();
      }
      return dailyRate;
    }
    return (this.a("rate",) as number) ?? 0;
  }

  /**
   * Compute the turnover (cost or revenue) for this resource.
   *
   * @see docs/taskjuggler/lib/taskjuggler/ResourceScenario.rb:turnover
   */
  turnover(
    startIdx: number,
    endIdx: number,
    account: Account,
    task: Task | null = null,
    includeKids: boolean = false,
  ): number {
    let amount = 0.0;
    if ((this.getProperty() as PropertyTreeNode).container?.() && includeKids) {
      for (const child of (this.getProperty() as PropertyTreeNode).kids()) {
        amount += (child as Resource).scenarioData(this.getScenarioIdx(),)
          .turnover(
            startIdx,
            endIdx,
            account,
            task,
          );
      }
    } else {
      if (task) {
        amount += (task as Task).scenarioData(this.getScenarioIdx(),).turnover(
          startIdx,
          endIdx,
          account,
          this.getProperty() as Resource,
        );
      } else if (!this.isChargesetEmpty()) {
        const totalResourceCost = this.cost(startIdx, endIdx,);
        const chargeset = this.a("chargeset",) as ChargeSet[];
        if (chargeset) {
          for (const set of chargeset) {
            set.each((accnt, share,) => {
              if (
                share !== null &&
                share > 0.0 &&
                (accnt === account || (accnt as any).isChildOf?.(account,))
              ) {
                amount += totalResourceCost * share;
              }
            },);
          }
        }
      }
    }

    // Bloco I: Integração com motor de atribuição (attribution engine)
    // Calcula linhas de custo e emite CostEvents para auditoria
    const resource = this.getProperty() as Resource;
    const scIdx = this.getScenarioIdx();
    const project = resource.project as ProjectLike;

    // Determinar se há chargeset disponível para atribuição
    const hasChargeset = this.a("chargeset",) as ChargeSet[];

    // 1. Linhas de custo de recursos (resource_effort)
    if (!task && hasChargeset && hasChargeset.length > 0) {
      const resourceCost = this.cost(startIdx, endIdx,);
      if (resourceCost > 0) {
        const line: CostLine = {
          type: "resource_effort",
          amount: resourceCost,
          resource: resource,
        };
        const attribution = resolveAccount(line,);
        // Emitir CostEvent
        const costEvent = createCostEvent(
          line,
          attribution.account,
          attribution.rule,
          scIdx,
          "planned", // modo planejado por default
        );
        project.costEvents.push(costEvent,);
        // Se a conta resolvida corresponde à conta solicitada, adicionar ao total
        if (
          attribution.account &&
          (attribution.account === account ||
            (attribution.account as any).isChildOf?.(account,))
        ) {
          amount += resourceCost;
        }
      }
    }

    return amount;
  }

  /**
   * Returns the cost for using this resource during the specified interval.
   *
   * @see docs/taskjuggler/lib/taskjuggler/ResourceScenario.rb:cost
   */
  cost(startIdx: number, endIdx: number, task: Task | null = null,): number {
    // Ruby uses @rate (the raw rate attribute), not the container-summing
    // rate() method, so a group resource's own rate is used directly.
    return this.getAllocatedTime(startIdx, endIdx, task,) *
      (this.a("rate",) as number);
  }

  /**
   * Check if the chargeset is empty.
   */
  private isChargesetEmpty(): boolean {
    const chargeset = this.a("chargeset",) as ChargeSet[] | undefined;
    if (!chargeset) return true;
    let empty = true;
    for (const set of chargeset) {
      set.each((_, share,) => {
        if (share !== null && share > 0.0) {
          empty = false;
        }
      },);
    }
    return empty;
  }
}
```

```ts
import { type ProjectLike, } from "./project-like.ts";
import { PropertyTreeNode, } from "./property-tree-node.ts";
import { ResourceScenario, } from "./resource-scenario.ts";
import { ChargeSetCollection, } from "../finance/charge-set-collection.ts";

export class Resource extends PropertyTreeNode {
  private chargeset_: ChargeSetCollection;

  constructor(
    project: ProjectLike,
    id: string | null,
    name: string,
    parent: Resource | null,
  ) {
    super(project.resources, id, name, parent,);
    project.addResource(this,);
    this.chargeset_ = new ChargeSetCollection();
    for (let i = 0; i < project.scenarioCount; i++) {

        this,

        this.getScenarioAttributes(i,),
      );
    }

    return this.data[scIdx]! as ResourceScenario;
  }

  get chargeset(): ChargeSetCollection {

  /**

  bookedEffort(scIdx: number,): number {

  }
}
```

```ts
import { type PropertyLike, } from "../model/property-like.ts";
import { type MessageHandlerLike, } from "../model/message-handler-like.ts";
import { type AttributeContainer, } from "../attributes/attribute-container.ts";
import { type AttributeBase, } from "../attributes/attribute-base.ts";
import { TjArgumentError, } from "../attributes/errors.ts";
import { type SourceFileInfo, } from "../model/property-tree-node.ts";

/**
 * Type guard to check if a PropertyLike is a PropertyTreeNode.
 * This is safe because ScenarioData is only used in Phase 4+ where
 * PropertyTreeNode exists.
 */
type PropertyTreeNodeLike = PropertyLike & {
  attributeDefinition(id: string,): AttributeDefinition<unknown> | undefined;
  getScenarioAttribute(
    scIdx: number,
    id: string,
  ): AttributeBase<unknown>;
};

import { type AttributeDefinition, } from "../attributes/attribute-definition.ts";

export class ScenarioData implements AttributeContainer {
  protected property: PropertyLike;
  protected scenarioIdx: number;
  private attributes: Map<string, AttributeBase<unknown>>;
  private _values: Map<string, unknown>;

  constructor(
    property: PropertyLike,
    scenarioIdx: number,
    attributes: Map<string, AttributeBase<unknown>>,
  ) {
    this.property = property;
    this.scenarioIdx = scenarioIdx;
    // Use a separate Map for attribute values to avoid conflict with scenarioAttributes
    this.attributes = new Map();
    this._values = new Map();
  }

  getProperty(): PropertyLike {
    return this.property;
  }

  getScenarioIdx(): number {
    return this.scenarioIdx;
  }

  getAttributes(): Map<string, AttributeBase<unknown>> {
    return this.attributes;
  }

  getStoredValue(attributeId: string,): unknown {
    return this._values.get(attributeId,) ?? null;
  }

  setStoredValue(attributeId: string, value: unknown,): void {
    this._values.set(attributeId, value,);
  }

  a(attributeName: string,): unknown {
    const attr = this.attributes.get(attributeName,);
    if (!attr) {
      return null;
    }
    return attr.get();
  }

  error(
    id: string,
    text: string,
    sfi?: string | SourceFileInfo | null,
    property?: PropertyLike,
  ): void {
    // TODO(#issue): Implement MessageHandler integration
    console.error(`[${id}] ${text}`,);
  }

  warning(
    id: string,
    text: string,
    sfi?: string | SourceFileInfo | null,
    property?: PropertyLike,
  ): void {
    // TODO(#issue): Implement MessageHandler integration
    console.warn(`[${id}] ${text}`,);
  }

  info(
    id: string,
    text: string,
    sfi?: string | SourceFileInfo | null,
    property?: PropertyLike,
  ): void {
    // TODO(#issue): Implement MessageHandler integration
    console.log(`[${id}] ${text}`,);
  }

  deepClone(): this {
    return this;
  }

  /**
   * Pré-carrega atributos de cenário, criando cada AttributeBase
   * se ainda não existir. Usado pelos *Scenario constructors
   * (ADR 016) para replicar o comportamento do Ruby.
   */
  preloadAttributes(ids: string[],): void {
    for (const id of ids) {
      // Cast to PropertyTreeNode to access attributeDefinition and getScenarioAttribute
      const propertyTreeNode = this.property as PropertyTreeNodeLike;
      const aDef = propertyTreeNode.attributeDefinition(id,);
      if (!aDef) {
        throw new TjArgumentError(`Unknown attribute '${id}'`,);
      }
      const attr = propertyTreeNode.getScenarioAttribute(
        this.scenarioIdx,
        id,
      );
      this.attributes.set(id, attr,);
    }
  }
}
```

```ts
import { type ProjectLike, } from "./project-like.ts";
import { PropertyTreeNode, } from "./property-tree-node.ts";
import { PropertySet, } from "./property-set.ts";
import { ScenarioData, } from "./scenario-data.ts";

export class Scenario extends PropertyTreeNode {
  constructor(
    project: ProjectLike,
    id: string,
    name: string,
    parent: PropertyTreeNode | null,
  ) {
    super(project.scenarios, id, name, parent,);
  }

  override all(): Scenario[] {
    const result: Scenario[] = [this,];
    this.kids().forEach((child,) => {
      if (child instanceof Scenario) {
        result.push(...child.all(),);
      }
    },);
    return result;
  }

  override allLeaves(includeSelf: boolean = false,): Scenario[] {
    const result: Scenario[] = [];
    if (this.leaf()) {
      if (includeSelf) {
        result.push(this,);
      }
    } else {
      this.kids().forEach((child,) => {
        if (child instanceof Scenario) {
          result.push(...child.allLeaves(),);
        }
      },);
    }
    return result;
  }

  override scenarioData(scIdx: number,): ScenarioData {
    return this.data[scIdx]!;
  }
}
```

```ts
    if (!wh) {

  replace(): boolean {

  }

   * Retorna true se o shift tem férias definidas para a data.
   *
   * @see docs/taskjuggler/lib/taskjuggler/ShiftScenario.rb:onLeave?
   */
  onLeave(date: TjTime,): boolean {
    const leaves = this.a("leaves",) as Iterable<
      { interval: { contains(d: TjTime,): boolean } }
    >;
    if (!leaves) {
      return false;
    }
    for (const leave of leaves) {

        return true;
      }
    }
    return false;
  }
```
