```ts
import { assertEquals, } from "@std/assert";
import { describe, it, } from "@std/testing/bdd";
import { CANONICAL_KEYWORDS, } from "../../src/i18n/canonical.ts";
import { en, } from "../../src/i18n/en.ts";
import { ptBR, } from "../../src/i18n/pt-BR.ts";
import { es, } from "../../src/i18n/es.ts";
import { globalRegistry, } from "../../src/i18n/mod.ts";
import type { LanguageDefinition, } from "../../src/i18n/types.ts";

const LANGS = [en, ptBR, es,];

describe("Idiomas (10.16)", () => {
  it("10.16.2 en cobre todos os canônicos com identidade", () => {
    assertEquals(Object.keys(en.keywords,).length, CANONICAL_KEYWORDS.length,);
    for (const k of CANONICAL_KEYWORDS) {
      assertEquals(en.keywords[k], [k,],);
    }
  });

  it("10.16.3 en.units tem as 6 unidades do spec (+quarter)", () => {
    assertEquals(en.units.day, ["d", "day", "days",],);
    assertEquals(en.units.hour, ["h", "hour", "hours",],);
    assertEquals(en.units.week, ["w", "week", "weeks",],);
    assertEquals(en.units.month?.includes("mo",), true,);
    assertEquals(en.units.year?.includes("y",), true,);
    assertEquals(en.units.minute?.includes("min",), true,);
    assertEquals(en.units.quarter?.includes("q",), true,);
  });

  it("10.16.4 pt-BR cobre todos os ~200 canônicos", () => {
    assertEquals(
      Object.keys(ptBR.keywords,).length,
      CANONICAL_KEYWORDS.length,
    );
    assertEquals(ptBR.keywords.project, ["projeto",],);
    assertEquals(ptBR.keywords.task, ["tarefa",],);
    assertEquals(ptBR.keywords.effort, ["esforço",],);
    assertEquals(ptBR.keywords.depends, ["depende",],);
  });

  it("10.16.5 pt-BR units traduzidas", () => {
    assertEquals(ptBR.units.day, ["d", "dia", "dias",],);
    assertEquals(ptBR.units.hour?.includes("horas",), true,);
    assertEquals(ptBR.units.week?.includes("semana",), true,);
    assertEquals(ptBR.units.month?.includes("mês",), true,);
    assertEquals(ptBR.units.year?.includes("ano",), true,);
    assertEquals(ptBR.units.minute?.includes("minuto",), true,);
  });

  it("10.16.6 es cobre todos os ~200 canônicos", () => {
    assertEquals(Object.keys(es.keywords,).length, CANONICAL_KEYWORDS.length,);
    assertEquals(es.keywords.project, ["proyecto",],);
    assertEquals(es.keywords.task, ["tarea",],);
    assertEquals(es.keywords.workinghours, ["horaslaborales",],);
  });

  it("10.16.7 es units traduzidas", () => {
    assertEquals(es.units.day?.includes("día",), true,);
    assertEquals(es.units.hour?.includes("horas",), true,);
    assertEquals(es.units.week?.includes("semana",), true,);
    assertEquals(es.units.month?.includes("meses",), true,);
    assertEquals(es.units.year?.includes("año",), true,);
    assertEquals(es.units.minute?.includes("minutos",), true,);
  });

  it("10.16.8 os 3 idiomas cobrem os mesmos canônicos", () => {
    const canonical: Set<string> = new Set(CANONICAL_KEYWORDS,);
    for (const lang of LANGS) {
      const keys = new Set(Object.keys(lang.keywords,),);
      assertEquals(keys.size, canonical.size, lang.id,);
      for (const k of keys) {

          `${lang.id}: ${k} não é canônico`,
        );
      }
    }
  });

  it("10.16.9 nenhum sinônimo colide dentro do mesmo idioma", () => {

    }
  });

  it("10.16.10 aggregate: globalRegistry resolve nas 3 línguas", () => {
    assertEquals(globalRegistry.resolve("tarefa", "pt-BR",), "task",);
    assertEquals(globalRegistry.resolve("tarea", "es",), "task",);
    assertEquals(globalRegistry.resolve("task", "es",), "task",);
    assertEquals(globalRegistry.resolve("effort", "pt-BR",), "effort",);
    assertEquals(globalRegistry.resolve("recurso", "pt-BR",), "resource",);
    assertEquals(globalRegistry.resolve("informe", "es",), "report",);
    assertEquals(globalRegistry.resolve("banana", "pt-BR",), null,);

function assertNoCollision(lang: LanguageDefinition,) {
  const seen = new Map<string, string>();
  const add = (from: string, to: string,) => {

  };
  for (const [canonical, synonyms,] of Object.entries(lang.keywords,)) {
    add(canonical, canonical,);
    for (const s of synonyms) add(s, canonical,);
  }
  const seenUnits = new Map<string, string>();
  const addU = (from: string, to: string,) => {
    const prev = seenUnits.get(from,);
    assertEquals(
      prev === undefined || prev === to,
      true,
      `${lang.id}: unidade '${from}' colide (${prev} vs ${to})`,
    );
    seenUnits.set(from, to,);
  };
  for (const [canonical, synonyms,] of Object.entries(lang.units,)) {
    addU(canonical, canonical,);
    for (const s of synonyms) addU(s, canonical,);
  }
}
```

```ts
import { assertEquals, } from "@std/assert";
import { describe, it, } from "@std/testing/bdd";
import { LanguageRegistry, } from "../../src/i18n/registry.ts";
import { CANONICAL_KEYWORDS, } from "../../src/i18n/canonical.ts";
import { en, } from "../../src/i18n/en.ts";
import type { LanguageDefinition, } from "../../src/i18n/types.ts";

const ptTest: LanguageDefinition = {
  id: "pt-BR",
  name: "Português (Brasil)",
  keywords: { project: ["projeto",], task: ["tarefa",], },
  units: { day: ["dia", "dias",], },
};

describe("LanguageRegistry", () => {
  it("10.15.5 register + get retorna a definição", () => {
    const reg = new LanguageRegistry();
    reg.register(en,);
    reg.register(ptTest,);
    assertEquals(reg.get("pt-BR",)?.name, "Português (Brasil)",);
    assertEquals(reg.get("en",)?.id, "en",);
  });

  it("10.15.5 re-registrar o mesmo id substitui", () => {
    const reg = new LanguageRegistry();
    reg.register(ptTest,);
    reg.register({ ...ptTest, name: "PT-BR v2", },);
    assertEquals(reg.get("pt-BR",)?.name, "PT-BR v2",);
  });

  it("10.15.6 get de idioma inexistente retorna null", () => {
    const reg = new LanguageRegistry();
    reg.register(en,);
    assertEquals(reg.get("de",), null,);
    assertEquals(reg.get("",), null,);
    // após registrar, passa a encontrar
    reg.register(ptTest,);
    assertEquals(reg.get("pt-BR",)?.id, "pt-BR",);
  });

  it("10.15.7 all lista idiomas na ordem de registro", () => {
    const reg = new LanguageRegistry();
    reg.register(en,);
    reg.register(ptTest,);
    assertEquals(reg.all().map((l,) => l.id), ["en", "pt-BR",],);
  });

  it("10.15.8 resolve traduz sinônimo para o canônico", () => {
    const reg = new LanguageRegistry();
    reg.register(en,);
    reg.register(ptTest,);
    assertEquals(reg.resolve("projeto", "pt-BR",), "project",);
    assertEquals(reg.resolve("tarefa", "pt-BR",), "task",);
  });

  it("10.15.8 resolve tem fallback inglês para canônicos", () => {
    const reg = new LanguageRegistry();
    reg.register(en,);
    reg.register(ptTest,);
    assertEquals(reg.resolve("task", "pt-BR",), "task",);
    assertEquals(reg.resolve("effort", "en",), "effort",);
  });

  it("10.15.8 resolve case-sensitive não traduz variações", () => {
    const reg = new LanguageRegistry();
    reg.register(en,);
    reg.register(ptTest,);
    assertEquals(reg.resolve("Tarefa", "pt-BR",), null,);
    assertEquals(reg.resolve("projeto", "en",), null,);
  });

  it("10.15.8 resolve de palavra desconhecida retorna null", () => {
    const reg = new LanguageRegistry();
    reg.register(en,);
    assertEquals(reg.resolve("banana", "en",), null,);
    assertEquals(reg.resolve("qualquer", "xx",), null,);
  });

  it("10.15.8 register lança em sinônimo duplicado (colisão)", () => {
    const reg = new LanguageRegistry();
    const bad: LanguageDefinition = {
      id: "bad",
      name: "Bad",
      keywords: { task: ["x",], project: ["x",], },
      units: {},
    };
    let threw = false;
    try {
      reg.register(bad,);
    } catch {
      threw = true;
    }
    assertEquals(threw, true,);
  });

  it("10.15.9 resolveUnit traduz unidades locais", () => {
    const reg = new LanguageRegistry();
    reg.register(en,);
    reg.register(ptTest,);
    assertEquals(reg.resolveUnit("dias", "pt-BR",), "day",);
    assertEquals(reg.resolveUnit("d", "pt-BR",), "day",); // fallback en
    assertEquals(reg.resolveUnit("h", "en",), "hour",);
    assertEquals(reg.resolveUnit("xyz", "en",), null,);
  });

  it("10.15.10 canonicalizeKeywords mescla idioma + fallback en", () => {
    const reg = new LanguageRegistry();
    reg.register(en,);
    reg.register(ptTest,);
    const map = reg.canonicalizeKeywords("pt-BR",);
    assertEquals(map.get("projeto",), "project",);
    assertEquals(map.get("effort",), "effort",); // via en
    // idioma tem prioridade sobre sobreposição do en
    const overlapped = reg.canonicalizeKeywords("xx",);
    assertEquals(overlapped.get("projeto",), undefined,);
  });

  it("10.15.12 dois idiomas resolvem o mesmo canônico", () => {
    const reg = new LanguageRegistry();
    const esTest: LanguageDefinition = {
      id: "es",
      name: "Español",
      keywords: { project: ["proyecto",], task: ["tarea",], },
      units: { day: ["día",], },
    };
    reg.register(en,);
    reg.register(ptTest,);
    reg.register(esTest,);
    assertEquals(reg.resolve("projeto", "pt-BR",), "project",);
    assertEquals(reg.resolve("proyecto", "es",), "project",);
    assertEquals(reg.resolve("tarea", "es",), "task",);
    assertEquals(reg.resolve("tarefa", "pt-BR",), "task",);
    // "tarea" não é sinônimo em pt-BR (pt usa "tarefa")
    assertEquals(reg.resolve("tarea", "pt-BR",), null,);
  });

  it("10.15.2 CANONICAL_KEYWORDS tem >= 200 keywords e sem duplicatas", () => {
    assertEquals(CANONICAL_KEYWORDS.length >= 200, true,);
    assertEquals(new Set(CANONICAL_KEYWORDS,).size, CANONICAL_KEYWORDS.length,);
  });
});
```

```ts
import { beforeEach, describe, it, } from "@std/testing/bdd";
import { assert, assertEquals, } from "@std/assert";
import { createTestProject, } from "../fixtures/create-test-project.ts";
import { Project, } from "../../src/model/project.ts";
import { Limits, } from "../../src/scheduling/limits.ts";
import { ShiftAssignments, } from "../../src/scheduling/shift-assignments.ts";

import { TimeInterval, } from "../../src/time/time-interval.ts";
import { TjTime, } from "../../src/time/tj-time.ts";
import { ShiftAssignment, } from "../../src/scheduling/shift-assignments.ts";
import { projectObjectId, } from "../../src/utils/project-object-id.ts";
import { ResourceScenario, } from "../../src/model/resource-scenario.ts";
import { Resource, } from "../../src/model/resource.ts";

describe("Smoke test after Phase 6", () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    // Configurar modo global (Fase 3)
    // (AttributeBase.setMode(0) é chamado automaticamente em beforeEach dos testes)
  },);

  it("cria Limits e verifica tipos de limite", () => {
    const project = createTestProject(1,);
    const limits = new Limits();
    limits.setProject(project,);

    // Testar cada tipo de limite
    limits.setLimit("dailymax", 3600,);
    assertEquals(limits.limits.length, 1,);
    assertEquals(limits.limits[0]!.name, "dailymax",);

    limits.setLimit("weeklymax", 7 * 3600,);
    assertEquals(limits.limits.length, 2,);
    assertEquals(limits.limits[1]!.name, "weeklymax",);

    limits.setLimit("monthlymax", 30 * 3600,);
    assertEquals(limits.limits.length, 3,);
    assertEquals(limits.limits[2]!.name, "monthlymax",);

    limits.setLimit("maximum", 3600,);
    assertEquals(limits.limits.length, 4,);
    assertEquals(limits.limits[3]!.name, "maximum",);
  });

  it("verifica ShiftAssignments com atribuição", () => {
    const project = createTestProject(1,);
    const shift = new Shift(project, "shift1", "Shift 1", null,);
    const wh = new WorkingHours(
      3600,
      (project.get("start",) as TjTime).toDate(),
      (project.get("end",) as TjTime).toDate(),
    );
    wh.setWorkingHours(1, [[9 * 3600, 17 * 3600,],],);
    shift.setForScenario("workinghours", wh, 0,);

    const assignments = new ShiftAssignments();
    assignments.project = project;

    const interval = new TimeInterval(
      TjTime.fromDate(new Date("2026-01-01T09:00:00Z",),),
      TjTime.fromDate(new Date("2026-01-01T17:00:00Z",),),
    );
    const sa = new ShiftAssignment(shift.scenarioData(0,), interval,);
    const result = assignments.addAssignment(sa,);
    assertEquals(result, true,);
    assertEquals(assignments.assignments.length, 1,);

    // Verificar que o encoding de bits funciona
    // Slot 0 = 2026-01-01T00:00Z (fora do intervalo 09:00-17:00)
    const slot0 = assignments.getSbSlot(0,);
    assertEquals(slot0, 0,);
    // Slot 9 = 2026-01-01T09:00Z (dentro do intervalo)
    const slot9 = assignments.getSbSlot(9,);
    assertEquals(slot9, 1,); // BIT_ASSIGNED = 1
  });

  it("verifica ShiftScenario consolidado", () => {
    const project = createTestProject(1,);
    const shift = new Shift(project, "shift1", "Shift 1", null,);
    const wh = new WorkingHours(
      3600,
      (project.get("start",) as TjTime).toDate(),
      (project.get("end",) as TjTime).toDate(),
    );
    wh.setWorkingHours(1, [[9 * 3600, 17 * 3600,],],);
    shift.setForScenario("workinghours", wh, 0,);
    shift.setForScenario("replace", true, 0,);

    const shiftScenario = shift.scenarioData(0,);

    // Testar onShift?
    const date = TjTime.fromDate(new Date("2026-01-01T12:00:00Z",),);
    assertEquals(shiftScenario.onShift(date,), true,);

    // Testar replace?
    assertEquals(shiftScenario.replace(), true,);

    // Testar onLeave? (sem leaves)
    assertEquals(shiftScenario.onLeave(date,), false,);
  });

  it("verifica ResourceScenario.onShift?", () => {
    const project = createTestProject(1,);
    const resource = new Resource(project, "res1", "Resource 1", null,);
    const shifts = new ShiftAssignments();
    shifts.project = project;

    // Configurar shifts no recurso (Ruby: @property['shifts', @scenarioIdx])
    resource.setForScenario("shifts", shifts, 0,);

    const resourceScenario = resource.scenarioData(0,) as ResourceScenario;
```

```ts
import { beforeEach, describe, it, } from "@std/testing/bdd";
import { assert, assertEquals, } from "@std/assert";
import { createTestProject, } from "../fixtures/create-test-project.ts";
import { Project, } from "../../src/model/project.ts";
import { Task, } from "../../src/model/task.ts";
import { Resource, } from "../../src/model/resource.ts";
import { Account, } from "../../src/model/account.ts";
import { Charge, } from "../../src/finance/charge.ts";
import { ChargeSet, } from "../../src/finance/charge-set.ts";
import { AccountCredit, } from "../../src/finance/account-credit.ts";
import { TjTime, } from "../../src/time/tj-time.ts";
import { TimeInterval, } from "../../src/time/time-interval.ts";

describe("Smoke test after Phase 8", () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    // Configurar modo global (Fase 3)
    // (AttributeBase.setMode(0) é chamado automaticamente em beforeEach dos testes)
  },);

  it("cria Charge com 3 modos válidos", () => {
    const project = createTestProject(1,);
    const task = new Task(project, "t1", "Task 1", null,);

    const charge1 = new Charge(100, "onStart", task, 0,);
    assertEquals(charge1.mode, "onStart",);
    assertEquals(charge1.amount, 100,);

    const charge2 = new Charge(200, "onEnd", task, 0,);
    assertEquals(charge2.mode, "onEnd",);

    const charge3 = new Charge(300, "perDiem", task, 0,);
    assertEquals(charge3.mode, "perDiem",);
  });

  it("calcula Charge.turnover para cada modo", () => {
    const project = createTestProject(1,);
    const task = new Task(project, "t1", "Task 1", null,);
    task.setForScenario("start", TjTime.fromString("2026-03-15"), 0,);
    task.setForScenario("end", TjTime.fromString("2026-03-20"), 0,);

    // Period must be wide enough to contain both start (03-15) and end (03-20).
    // TimeInterval is [start, end) exclusive, so end must be > 03-20.
    const period = new TimeInterval(
      TjTime.fromString("2026-03-10"),
      TjTime.fromString("2026-03-25"),
    );

    const chargeStart = new Charge(100, "onStart", task, 0,);
    assertEquals(chargeStart.turnover(period,), 100,);

    const chargeEnd = new Charge(200, "onEnd", task, 0,);
    assertEquals(chargeEnd.turnover(period,), 200,);

    const chargePerDiem = new Charge(100, "perDiem", task, 0,);
    // 5 dias (15,16,17,18,19) * 100 = 500 (exclusive of end 03-20)
    assertEquals(chargePerDiem.turnover(period,), 500,);
  });

  it("cria ChargeSet e adiciona accounts com shares", () => {
    const project = createTestProject(1,);
    const parentAccount = new Account(project, "parent", "Parent", null,);
    const account1 = new Account(project, "parent.acc1", "Account 1", parentAccount,);
    const account2 = new Account(project, "parent.acc2", "Account 2", parentAccount,);

    const chargeset = new ChargeSet();
    chargeset.addAccount(account1, 0.7,);
    chargeset.addAccount(account2, 0.3,);

    // ChargeSet.master returns the root account of the first member
    assertEquals(chargeset.master, parentAccount,);
    chargeset.complete();
    assertEquals(chargeset.share(account1), 0.7,);
    assertEquals(chargeset.share(account2), 0.3,);
  });

  it("cria AccountCredit com valores negativos", () => {
    const credit = new AccountCredit(
      TjTime.fromString("2026-03-15"),
      "Reimbursement",
      -50.0,
    );
    assertEquals(credit.amount, -50.0,);
    assertEquals(credit.description, "Reimbursement",);
  });

  it("cria meta-account (balance) com createBalanceAccount", () => {
    const project = createTestProject(1,);
    const costAccount = new Account(project, "cost", "Cost", null,);
    const revenueAccount = new Account(project, "rev", "Revenue", null,);

    // Project doesn't have newAccount method, so create meta account directly
    // and push cost/revenue accounts to adoptees manually (same pattern as balance-account_test.ts)
    const balance = new Account(project, "_balance_1", "Total", null,);
    balance.adoptees.push(costAccount, revenueAccount,);
    assert(balance.id.startsWith("_balance_",),);

    // Verifica que adoptees[0] = cost, adoptees[1] = revenue
    const adoptees = balance.adoptees;
    assertEquals(adoptees.length, 2,);
    assertEquals(adoptees[0], costAccount,);
    assertEquals(adoptees[1], revenueAccount,);
  });

  it("verifica Fase 7 (TaskScenario.schedule) ainda funciona", () => {
    const project = createTestProject(1,);
    const task = new Task(project, "t1", "Task 1", null,);

    // TaskScenario deve existir e ter método schedule
    const scenario = task.scenarioData(0,) as
      | import("../../src/model/task-scenario.ts").TaskScenario
      | undefined;
    assert(scenario !== undefined,);
    assert(typeof scenario.schedule === "function",);
  });
});
```

```ts
import { describe, it, } from "@std/testing/bdd";
import { assertEquals, assertThrows, } from "@std/assert";
import { Macro, MacroTable, } from "../../src/lexer/macro-table.ts";
import { SourceFileInfo, } from "../../src/source-file-info.ts";

const sfi = new SourceFileInfo("test.tjp", 1, 1,);

describe("Macro", () => {
  it("armazena name, value e sourceFileInfo", () => {
    const macro = new Macro("greeting", "Hello ${1}!", sfi,);
    assertEquals(macro.name, "greeting",);
    assertEquals(macro.value, "Hello ${1}!",);
    assertEquals(macro.sourceFileInfo, sfi,);
  });

  it("rejeita name vazio", () => {
    assertThrows(() => new Macro("", "x", sfi,), Error, "empty",);
  });

  it("rejeita name null-ish (undefined como any-free)", () => {
    assertThrows(
      () => new Macro(undefined as unknown as string, "x", sfi,),
      Error,
    );
  });
});

describe("MacroTable", () => {
  it("add armazena macro por nome", () => {
    const table = new MacroTable();
    table.add(new Macro("a", "A", sfi,),);
    assertEquals(table.includes("a",), true,);
  });

  it("add substitui macro de mesmo nome", () => {
    const table = new MacroTable();
    table.add(new Macro("a", "A1", sfi,),);
    table.add(new Macro("a", "A2", sfi,),);
    const resolved = table.resolve(["a",], sfi,);
    assertEquals(resolved?.[1], "A2",);
  });

  it("clear remove todas as macros", () => {
    const table = new MacroTable();
    table.add(new Macro("a", "A", sfi,),);
    table.clear();
    assertEquals(table.includes("a",), false,);
  });

  it("include retorna false para macro inexistente", () => {
    const table = new MacroTable();
    assertEquals(table.includes("zz",), false,);
  });

  it("include retorna true para macro existente", () => {
    const table = new MacroTable();
    table.add(new Macro("ok", "V", sfi,),);
    assertEquals(table.includes("ok",), true,);
  });

  it("resolve retorna null para macro inexistente", () => {
    const table = new MacroTable();
    assertEquals(table.resolve(["nao_existe",], sfi,), null,);
  });

  it("resolve com prefixo '?' retorna null se macro não existe", () => {
    const table = new MacroTable();
    assertEquals(table.resolve(["?opcional",], sfi,), null,);
  });

  it("resolve com prefixo '?' retorna macro com texto vazio se existe", () => {
    const table = new MacroTable();
    table.add(new Macro("existe", "X", sfi,),);
    const result = table.resolve(["?existe",], sfi,);
    assertEquals(result?.[0].name, "existe",);
    assertEquals(result?.[1], "",);
  });

  it("resolve retorna a macro e o valor quando não opcional", () => {
    const table = new MacroTable();
    table.add(new Macro("a", "valor", sfi,),);
    const result = table.resolve(["a",], sfi,);
    assertEquals(result?.[0].value, "valor",);
    assertEquals(result?.[1], "valor",);
  });

  it("resolve substitui ${1} pelo primeiro argumento", () => {
    const table = new MacroTable();
    table.add(new Macro("greet", "Hello ${1}!", sfi,),);
    const result = table.resolve(["greet", "Mundo",], sfi,);
    assertEquals(result?.[1], "Hello Mundo!",);
  });

  it("resolve substitui múltiplos argumentos ${1}, ${2}", () => {
    const table = new MacroTable();
    table.add(new Macro("dois", "${1} e ${2}", sfi,),);
    const result = table.resolve(["dois", "pao", "queijo",], sfi,);
    assertEquals(result?.[1], "pao e queijo",);
  });

  it("resolve desescapa $${ para ${", () => {
    const table = new MacroTable();
    table.add(new Macro("lit", "$${naoExpandir}", sfi,),);
    const result = table.resolve(["lit",], sfi,);
    assertEquals(result?.[1], "${naoExpandir}",);
  });
});
```

```ts
import { assert, assertEquals, } from "@std/assert";
import { describe, it, } from "@std/testing/bdd";
import { Log, } from "../../src/log.ts";
import { MessageHandlerInstance, } from "../../src/message-handler.ts";
import { ProjectFileScanner, } from "../../src/lexer/project-file-scanner.ts";
import { Macro, } from "../../src/lexer/macro-table.ts";
import { LanguageRegistry, } from "../../src/i18n/registry.ts";
import { en, } from "../../src/i18n/en.ts";
import { ptBR, } from "../../src/i18n/pt-BR.ts";
import type { ScannerToken, } from "../../src/lexer/scanner.ts";
import { TjTime, } from "../../src/time/tj-time.ts";

/** Cria scanner sobre buffer de texto e acumula todos os tokens. */
function scanAll(
  text: string,
  language = "en",
  registry?: LanguageRegistry,
): ScannerToken[] {
  const scanner = new ProjectFileScanner(
    text + "\n",
    Log,
    language,
    registry,
  );
  scanner.open(true,);
  const tokens: ScannerToken[] = [];
  for (;;) {
    const t = scanner.nextToken();
    if (t[0] === "eof" || t[0] === "endOfText") break;
    // Zera o SourceFileInfo para facilitar as comparações.
    tokens.push([t[0], t[1], null,],);
  }
  return tokens;
}

function types(text: string, language = "en",): string[] {
  return scanAll(text, language,).map((t,) => t[0]);
}

function texts(text: string, language = "en",): unknown[] {
  return scanAll(text, language,).map((t,) => t[1]);
}

/**
 * Escaneia registrando as MACROs encontradas (papel do parser no Ruby:
 * rule_macro chama scanner.addMacro). Tokens MACRO não viram saída.
 */
function scanWithMacros(text: string,): ScannerToken[] {
  const scanner = new ProjectFileScanner(text, Log,);
  scanner.open(true,);
  const out: ScannerToken[] = [];
  for (;;) {
    const t = scanner.nextToken();
    if (t[0] === "eof" || t[0] === "endOfText") break;
    if (t[0] === "MACRO") {
      const body = String(t[1],).trim();
      const space = body.indexOf(" ",);
      const name = space < 0 ? body : body.slice(0, space,);
      let value = space < 0 ? "" : body.slice(space + 1,);
      // O parser (rule_macro) removeria as aspas do valor; aqui manual.
      if (value.startsWith('"',) && value.endsWith('"',)) {
        value = value.slice(1, -1,);
      }
      scanner.addMacro(
        new Macro(name, value, t[2] ?? scanner.sourceFileInfo(),),
      );
      continue;
    }
    out.push([t[0], t[1], null,],);
  }
  return out;
}

describe("ProjectFileScanner (10.9)", () => {
  // ---- 10.9.1 padrões ----

  it("10.9.1.3 espaços e comentários # viram nada", () => {
    assertEquals(scanAll("   \n",), [],);
    assertEquals(scanAll("# um comentário\ntask",), [["ID", "task", null,],],);
  });

  it("10.9.1.3 comentário // de linha única", () => {
    assertEquals(texts("// aaa\neffort",), ["effort",],);
  });

  it("10.9.1.3 comentário /* */ de linha única e multi-linha", () => {
    assertEquals(texts("/* x */ task",), ["task",],);
    assertEquals(
      texts("/* linha1\nlinha2\n*/ task",),
      ["task",],
    );
  });

  it("10.9.1.4 chamada de macro ${...} expande", () => {
    const tokens = scanWithMacros(
      '[ macrohello "hello world" ]\ntask ${macrohello}\n',
    );
    assertEquals(tokens.map((t,) => t[1]), ["task", "hello", "world",],);
  });

  it('10.9.1.4 macro com argumento ${name "arg"}', () => {
    const out = scanWithMacros(
      '[ greet "hello ${1}" ]\ntask ${greet "Bob"}\n',
    );
    assertEquals(out.map((t,) => String(t[1],)), ["task", "hello", "Bob",],);
  });

  it("10.9.1.4 variável de ambiente $(VAR) injeta valor", () => {
    const saved = ProjectFileScanner.envProvider;

    try {
      assertEquals(texts("foo$(MYTESTVAR)bar",), ["fooxyzbar",],);
      assertEquals(texts("$(MYTESTVAR)",), ["xyz",],);
      // Desconhecida: erro unknown_env_var, sem token.

      const ids = MessageHandlerInstance.instance.messages.map((m,) => m.id);
      assert(ids.includes("unknown_env_var",),);

    }
  });

  it("10.9.1.5 ID_WITH_COLON 'foo:' chopa o dois-pontos", () => {
    assertEquals(scanAll("foo:",), [["ID_WITH_COLON", "foo", null,],],);
  });

  it("10.9.1.5 ABSOLUTE_ID a.b.c", () => {
```

```ts
const basePatterns: TokenPattern[] = [

  ["ID", /[A-Za-z_]\w*/, ":tjp", null,],
  ["LIT", /[^]/, ":tjp", null,],
];

function makeScanner(text: string, patterns = basePatterns,): Scanner {

  s.open(true,);
  return s;
}

    assertEquals(s.nextToken()[0], "ID",);
    assertEquals(s.nextToken()[1], "dois",);
    assertEquals(s.nextToken()[1], "tres",);
  });

  it("eof e endOfText fecham o stream em duas etapas", () => {
    const s = makeScanner("x",);
    s.nextToken(); // x
    const eofTok = s.nextToken();
    assertEquals(eofTok[0], "eof",);

    assertEquals(eot[0], "endOfText",);

  });

  it("returnToken devolve o mesmo token na próxima leitura", () => {
    const s = makeScanner("x y",);
    const t = s.nextToken();
    s.returnToken(t,);
    assertEquals(s.nextToken(), t,);
    assertEquals(s.nextToken()[1], "y",);
  });

  it("dois returnToken em sequência lançam erro fatal", () => {
    const s = makeScanner("x",);
    const t = s.nextToken();
    s.returnToken(t,);
    assertThrows(
      () => s.returnToken(t,),
      Error,
      "Cannot return more than 1 token",
    );
  });

  it("postProc pode reescrever tipo e texto", () => {
    const patterns: TokenPattern[] = [[
      "ID",
      /[a-z]+/,
      ":tjp",
      (type, text,) => [type === "ID" ? "KEYWORD" : type, text.toUpperCase(),],
    ],];
    const s = new Scanner("ola", Log, patterns, ":tjp",);
    s.open(true,);
    assertEquals(s.nextToken(), ["KEYWORD", "OLA", s.startOfToken!,],);
  });

  it("caractere sem match loga no_token_match (comportamento Ruby)", () => {
    const patterns: TokenPattern[] = [["ID", /[a-z]+/, ":tjp", null,],];
    const s = new Scanner("abc", Log, patterns, ":tjp",);
    s.open(true,);
    // Sem pattern de fallback, invocar nextToken em '!' looparia como no
    // Ruby. Validamos o caminho de erro chamando a API diretamente.
    s.cf!.readyNextLine();
    s.cf!.scan(/abc/,);
    s.error("no_token_match_probe", "Unexpected characters found",);
    const msgs = MessageHandlerInstance.instance.messages;
    assert(msgs.some((m,) => m.id === "no_token_match_probe"),);
  });

  it("token não terminado fora do modo default loga runaway_token", () => {
    const patterns: TokenPattern[] = [
      [null, /\s+/, ":tjp", null,],
      ["ID", /[a-z]+/, ":tjp", null,],
      ["STR", /"[^"]*"/, ":dqString", null,],
      [null, /[^]/, ":dqString", null,],
    ];
    const s = new Scanner('abc "unterminated', Log, patterns, ":tjp",);
    s.open(true,);
    s.nextToken(); // abc
    s.mode = ":dqString";
    // A partir daqui tudo é ignorado caractere a caractere até o fim do
    // arquivo, que dispara runaway_token por estar fora do modo default.
    const t = s.nextToken();
    assertEquals(t[0], "eof",);
    const msgs = MessageHandlerInstance.instance.messages;
    assert(msgs.some((m,) => m.id === "runaway_token"),);
  });
});

      string,
    ] => {

      hostRef.s!.expandMacro("", args, text.length,);
      return [null, text,];
    };
    const patterns: TokenPattern[] = [
      [null, /\s+/, ":tjp", null,],
      ["ID", /[a-z]+/, ":tjp", null,],
      [null, /\$\{[^}]*\}/, ":tjp", macroCall,],
    ];
    const s = new Scanner("${greet mundo}", Log, patterns, ":tjp",);
    hostRef.s = s;
    s.addMacro(new Macro("greet", "oi ${1}", new SourceFileInfo("f", 1, 1,),),);

      ),

    s.addMacro(new Macro("vazia", "", new SourceFileInfo("f", 1, 1,),),);

});
```

```ts
import { beforeEach, describe, it } from "@std/testing/bdd";
```

```ts
    // Como não temos um método real de custo de task, vamos usar um mock
    // Na implementação real, taskScenario.turnover() popularia os buckets
    const scenario = root.scenarioData(0,);

    const total = scenario.turnover(0, 365,);
```

```ts
import { describe, it } from "@std/testing/bdd";
import { assert, assertEquals, assertThrows } from "@std/assert";
import { TjTime, } from "../../src/time/tj-time.ts";
import { TimeInterval, } from "../../src/time/time-interval.ts";
import { ExtendedBooking, } from "../../src/model/extended-booking.ts";

describe("ExtendedBooking", () => {
  it("effort", () => {
    const date = TjTime.fromString("2026-11-01");
    const booking = new ExtendedBooking("effort", 20, date,);
    assertEquals(booking.type, "effort");
    assertEquals(booking.value, 20);
  });

  it("charge", () => {
    const date = TjTime.fromString("2026-11-03");
    const booking = new ExtendedBooking("charge", 1200, date,);
    assertEquals(booking.type, "charge");
    assertEquals(booking.value, 1200);
  });

  it("material", () => {
    const date = TjTime.fromString("2026-11-03");
    const booking = new ExtendedBooking("material", 550, date,);
    assertEquals(booking.type, "material");
    assertEquals(booking.value, 550);
  });

  it("com intervalo", () => {
    const start = TjTime.fromString("2026-11-01");
    const end = TjTime.fromString("2026-11-05");
    const interval = new TimeInterval(start, end,);
    const booking = new ExtendedBooking("effort", 20, start, interval,);
    assertEquals(booking.interval, interval);
  });

  it("rejeita value negativo para effort", () => {
    assertThrows(() => new ExtendedBooking("effort", -10, TjTime.fromString("2026-11-01"),), Error);
  });

  it("rejeita value negativo para material", () => {
    assertThrows(() => new ExtendedBooking("material", -10, TjTime.fromString("2026-11-01"),), Error);
  });

  it("aceita charge negativo", () => {
    const booking = new ExtendedBooking("charge", -1200, TjTime.fromString("2026-11-03"),);
    assertEquals(booking.value, -1200);
  });
});
```

```ts
  });

  it("slotsToDays converts correctly", () => {
    project.set("scheduleGranularity", 3600);
    const days = project.slotsToDays(8); // 8 slots = 1 working day (8h)
    assertEquals(days, 1);
  });

  it("convertToDailyLoad converts correctly", () => {
    const dailyLoad = project.convertToDailyLoad(8 * 3600); // 8 hours = 1 working day
    assertEquals(dailyLoad, 1);
  });

    const date = project.idxToDate(0);
    assertExists(date);
    assertEquals(date.toString(), "2026-01-01");
  });

  it("dateToIdx converts correctly", () => {
    const date = project.idxToDate(0);
    const idx = project.dateToIdx(date);
    assertEquals(idx, 0);
  });

  it("isWorkingTime returns true for working time", () => {
    const isWorking = project.isWorkingTime(0);
    assertEquals(isWorking, true);
  });

  it("hasWorkingTime returns same as isWorkingTime", () => {
    const hasWorking = project.hasWorkingTime(0);
    assertEquals(hasWorking, true);
  });

  it("workingDays counts working days in interval", () => {
    const days = project.workingDays({ start: 0, end: 10 });
    assertEquals(days, 11); // All days are working days by default
  });

  it("getWorkSlots counts work slots in interval", () => {
    const slots = project.getWorkSlots(0, 10);
    assertEquals(slots, 11); // All slots are working by default
  });

  it("attributeName returns attribute name", () => {
    const name = project.attributeName("id");
    assertEquals(name, "ID");

    const nonExistent = project.attributeName("nonexistent");
    assertEquals(nonExistent, undefined);
  });

  it("to_s returns string representation", () => {
    const str = project.to_s();
    assertEquals(str, "Project(id=test-project, name=Test Project, version=1.0.0)");
  });
});
```

```ts
import { beforeEach, describe, it, } from "@std/testing/bdd";
import { assertEquals, assertThrows, } from "@std/assert";
import { createTestProject, } from "../fixtures/create-test-project.ts";
import { Project, } from "../../src/model/project.ts";
import { PropertySet, } from "../../src/model/property-set.ts";
import { PropertyTreeNode, } from "../../src/model/property-tree-node.ts";
import { PTNProxy, } from "../../src/model/ptn-proxy.ts";
import {
  AttributeDefinition,
  AttributeType,
} from "../../src/attributes/attribute-definition.ts";

class TestProperty extends PropertyTreeNode {
  constructor(
    propertySet: PropertySet,
    id: string | null,
    name: string,
    parent: PropertyTreeNode | null,
  ) {
    super(propertySet, id, name, parent,);
  }
}

describe("PTNProxy", () => {
  let project: Project;
  let propertySet: PropertySet;
  let root: TestProperty;
  let child: TestProperty;

  beforeEach(() => {
    project = createTestProject(2,);
    propertySet = new PropertySet(project, false,);
    root = new TestProperty(propertySet, null, "root", null,);
    child = new TestProperty(propertySet, null, "child", root,);
  },);

  it("rejeita parent nulo", () => {
    assertThrows(
      () => new PTNProxy(child, null as unknown as PropertyTreeNode,),
      Error,
    );
  });

  it("logicalId respeita namespace plano", () => {
    const flatSet = new PropertySet(project, true,);
    const flatRoot = new TestProperty(flatSet, null, "root", null,);
    const flatChild = new TestProperty(flatSet, null, "child", flatRoot,);
    const proxy = new PTNProxy(flatChild, flatRoot,);
    assertEquals(proxy.logicalId(), flatChild.id,);
  });

  it("logicalId respeita namespace hierarquico", () => {
    const proxy = new PTNProxy(child, root,);
    assertEquals(proxy.logicalId(), child.id,);
  });

  it("get delega ao ptn", () => {
    const attrDef = new AttributeDefinition(
      "testAttr",
      "Test Attr",
      AttributeType.String,
      "default",
    );
    const newPropertySet = new PropertySet(project, false,);
    newPropertySet.addAttributeType(attrDef,);
    const newRoot = new TestProperty(newPropertySet, null, "root", null,);
    const newChild = new TestProperty(newPropertySet, null, "child", newRoot,);
    newChild.set("testAttr", "value",);
    const proxy = new PTNProxy(newChild, newRoot,);
    assertEquals(proxy.get("testAttr",), "value",);
  });

  it("set delega ao ptn", () => {
    const attrDef = new AttributeDefinition(
      "testAttr",
      "Test Attr",
      AttributeType.String,
      "default",
    );
    const newPropertySet = new PropertySet(project, false,);
    newPropertySet.addAttributeType(attrDef,);
    const newRoot = new TestProperty(newPropertySet, null, "root", null,);
    const newChild = new TestProperty(newPropertySet, null, "child", newRoot,);
    const proxy = new PTNProxy(newChild, newRoot,);
    proxy.set("testAttr", "value",);
    assertEquals(newChild.get("testAttr",), "value",);
  });

  it("level cacheado", () => {
    const proxy = new PTNProxy(child, root,);
    assertEquals(proxy.level, 2,);
  });

  it("isChildOf retorna true", () => {
    const proxy = new PTNProxy(child, root,);
    assertEquals(proxy.isChildOf(root,), true,);
  });

  it("isChildOf retorna false", () => {
    const proxy = new PTNProxy(child, root,);
    assertEquals(proxy.isChildOf(child,), false,);
  });

  it("getIndicies retorna array", () => {

    assertEquals(Array.isArray(proxy.getIndicies(),), true,);

  it("ptn retorna PropertyTreeNode", () => {

    assertEquals(proxy.ptn(), child,);
```

```ts
import { beforeEach, describe, it, } from "@std/testing/bdd";
import { assert, assertEquals, } from "@std/assert";
import { createTestProject, } from "../fixtures/create-test-project.ts";
import { Project, } from "../../src/model/project.ts";
import { Resource, } from "../../src/model/resource.ts";
import { ResourceScenario, } from "../../src/model/resource-scenario.ts";
import { Account, } from "../../src/model/account.ts";
import { Task, } from "../../src/model/task.ts";
import { ChargeSet, } from "../../src/finance/charge-set.ts";
import { TjTime, } from "../../src/time/tj-time.ts";

describe("ResourceScenario", () => {
  let project: Project;
  let resource: Resource;
  let resourceScenario: ResourceScenario;
  let account: Account;
  let task: Task;

  beforeEach(() => {
    project = createTestProject(1,);
    // Granularidade diária para que os índices correspondam a datas previsíveis.
    project.set("start", TjTime.fromString("2026-01-01",));
    project.set("end", TjTime.fromString("2026-12-31",));
    project.set("scheduleGranularity", 86400,);
    // 1 dia de trabalho = 24h para que os cálculos de custo sejam previsíveis
    // (365 dias * 100/h * 24h = 876000).
    project.set("dailyWorkingHours", 1,);
    resource = new Resource(project, "r1", "Resource 1", null,);
    resourceScenario = resource.scenarioData(0,);
    account = new Account(project, "acc1", "Account 1", null,);
    task = new Task(project, "t1", "Task 1", null,);
  },);

  /**
   * Reserva todos os slots do recurso para um task dummy no intervalo
   * [startIdx, endIdx), de modo que o custo do recurso seja não nulo.
   */
  function bookResourceFull(
    resourceScenario: ResourceScenario,
    startIdx: number,
    endIdx: number,
  ): void {
    for (let i = startIdx; i < endIdx; i++) {
      resourceScenario.book(i, task,);
    }
  }

  describe("turnover — sem chargeset", () => {
    it("retorna 0.0 para recurso sem chargeset", () => {
      assertEquals(resourceScenario.turnover(0, 365, account,), 0.0,);
    });

    it("retorna 0.0 para recurso container sem chargeset", () => {
      const childResource = new Resource(project, "r2", "Child Resource", resource,);
      assertEquals(resourceScenario.turnover(0, 365, account, null, true,), 0.0,);
    });
  });

  describe("turnover — com chargeset", () => {
    it("soma custo do recurso * share para conta", () => {
      resource.setForScenario("rate", 100, 0,);
      const chargeSet = new ChargeSet();
      chargeSet.addAccount(account, 0.5,);
      resource.setForScenario("chargeset", [chargeSet], 0,);
      bookResourceFull(resourceScenario, 0, 365,);
      // 365 dias * 100/h * 24h = 876000
      // 876000 * 0.5 = 438000
      assertEquals(resourceScenario.turnover(0, 365, account, null, false,), 438000.0,);
    });

    it("exclui conta com share 0", () => {
      resource.setForScenario("rate", 100, 0,);
      const chargeSet = new ChargeSet();
      chargeSet.addAccount(account, 0.0,);
      resource.setForScenario("chargeset", [chargeSet], 0,);
      bookResourceFull(resourceScenario, 0, 365,);
      assertEquals(resourceScenario.turnover(0, 365, account, null, false,), 0.0,);
    });

    it("inclui conta filha do account", () => {
      const childAccount = new Account(project, "acc2", "Child Account", account,);
      resource.setForScenario("rate", 100, 0,);
      const chargeSet = new ChargeSet();
      chargeSet.addAccount(childAccount, 1.0,);
      resource.setForScenario("chargeset", [chargeSet], 0,);
      bookResourceFull(resourceScenario, 0, 365,);
      // 365 dias * 100/h * 24h = 876000 (conta filha é incluída)
      assertEquals(resourceScenario.turnover(0, 365, account, null, false,), 876000.0,);
    });

    it("soma múltiplas contas com shares", () => {
      const childAccount1 = new Account(project, "acc2", "Child Account 1", account,);
      const childAccount2 = new Account(project, "acc3", "Child Account 2", account,);
      resource.setForScenario("rate", 100, 0,);
      const chargeSet = new ChargeSet();
      chargeSet.addAccount(childAccount1, 0.3,);
      chargeSet.addAccount(childAccount2, 0.7,);
      resource.setForScenario("chargeset", [chargeSet], 0,);
      bookResourceFull(resourceScenario, 0, 365,);
      // (365 * 100 * 24) * (0.3 + 0.7) = 876000
      assertEquals(resourceScenario.turnover(0, 365, account, null, false,), 876000.0,);
    });
  });

  describe("turnover — com task", () => {
    it("delega para task.turnover quando task fornecido", () => {
      task.setForScenario("start", TjTime.fromString("2026-01-01",), 0,);
      task.setForScenario("end", TjTime.fromString("2026-01-03",), 0,);
      const chargeSet = new ChargeSet();
      chargeSet.addAccount(account, 1.0,);
      task.setForScenario("chargeset", [chargeSet], 0,);
      // 2 dias * 24h * 100/h = 4800 (task tem rate padrão 0)
      assertEquals(resourceScenario.turnover(0, 365, account, task, false,), 0.0,);
    });

    it("delega para task.turnover com resource", () => {
      task.setForScenario("start", TjTime.fromString("2026-01-01",), 0,);
      task.setForScenario("end", TjTime.fromString("2026-01-03",), 0,);
      resource.setForScenario("rate", 100, 0,);
      const chargeSet = new ChargeSet();
      chargeSet.addAccount(account, 1.0,);
      resource.setForScenario("chargeset", [chargeSet], 0,);
      // Reserva apenas os 2 dias da task (índices 0-2), não todo o ano.
      bookResourceFull(resourceScenario, 0, 2,);
      // 2 dias * 24h * 100/h = 4800 (task usa rate do resource)
      assertEquals(resourceScenario.turnover(0, 365, account, task, false,), 4800.0,);
    });
  });

  describe("turnover — container recursivo", () => {
    it("soma turnover dos filhos container", () => {
      const childResource = new Resource(project, "r2", "Child Resource", resource,);
      childResource.setForScenario("rate", 100, 0,);
      const chargeSet = new ChargeSet();
      chargeSet.addAccount(account, 1.0,);
      childResource.setForScenario("chargeset", [chargeSet], 0,);
      bookResourceFull(
        childResource.scenarioData(0,),
        0,
        365,
      );
      // 365 dias * 100/h * 24h = 876000
      assertEquals(resourceScenario.turnover(0, 365, account, null, true,), 876000.0,);
    });

    it("recursão 3 níveis soma tudo", () => {
      const childResource = new Resource(project, "r2", "Child Resource", resource,);
      const grandchildResource = new Resource(project, "r3", "Grandchild Resource", childResource,);
      childResource.setForScenario("rate", 100, 0,);
      grandchildResource.setForScenario("rate", 50, 0,);
      const childChargeSet = new ChargeSet();
      childChargeSet.addAccount(account, 1.0,);
      const grandchildChargeSet = new ChargeSet();
      grandchildChargeSet.addAccount(account, 1.0,);
      childResource.setForScenario("chargeset", [childChargeSet], 0,);
      grandchildResource.setForScenario("chargeset", [grandchildChargeSet], 0,);
      bookResourceFull(
        childResource.scenarioData(0,),
        0,
        365,
      );
      bookResourceFull(
        grandchildResource.scenarioData(0,),
        0,
        365,
      );
      // (365 * 100 * 24) = 876000 (container r2 does NOT recurse into r3; r2's cost already includes r3's slots via treeSum valued at r2's rate)
      assertEquals(resourceScenario.turnover(0, 365, account, null, true,), 876000.0,);
    });
  });
});
```

```ts
describe("ResourceScenario.onShift?", () => {
  let project: Project;
  let resource: Resource;
  let scenario: ResourceScenario;

  beforeEach(() => {
    project = createTestProject(2,);
    project.set("start", TjTime.fromDate(new Date("2026-01-01T00:00:00Z",),),);
    project.set("scheduleGranularity", 3600,);
    resource = new Resource(project, "res1", "Resource 1", null,);
    scenario = resource.scenarioData(0,);
    ShiftAssignments.sbClear();
  },);

  it("usa workinghours quando shifts não atribuídos", () => {
    // 2026-01-05 é segunda-feira.
    const start = new Date("2026-01-05T00:00:00Z",);
    const end = new Date("2026-01-12T00:00:00Z",);
    const wh = new WorkingHours(3600, start, end,);
    wh.setWorkingHours(1, [[9 * 60 * 60, 17 * 60 * 60,],],);
    resource.setForScenario("workinghours", wh, 0,);

    // sbIdx 10 = 2026-01-05T10:00Z (Monday 10am)
    assertEquals(scenario.onShift(10,), true,);
    // sbIdx 20 = 2026-01-05T20:00Z (Monday 8pm)
    assertEquals(scenario.onShift(20,), false,);
    // sbIdx 0 = 2026-01-05T00:00Z (Monday midnight)
    assertEquals(scenario.onShift(0,), false,);
  });

  it("retorna true quando workinghours ausente", () => {
    assertEquals(scenario.onShift(10,), true,);
  });

  it("prioriza shifts sobre workinghours", () => {
    const start = new Date("2026-01-01T00:00:00Z",);
    const end = new Date("2026-01-08T00:00:00Z",);
    const wh = new WorkingHours(3600, start, end,);
    wh.setWorkingHours(1, [[9 * 60 * 60, 17 * 60 * 60,],],);
    resource.setForScenario("workinghours", wh, 0,);

    const shift = new Shift(project, "night", "Night", null,);
    const shiftScenario = shift.scenarioData(0,);
    const interval = new TimeInterval(
      TjTime.fromDate(new Date("2026-01-01T20:00:00Z",),),
      TjTime.fromDate(new Date("2026-01-02T04:00:00Z",),),
    );
    const sas = new ShiftAssignments();
    sas.project = project;
    sas.addAssignment(new ShiftAssignment(shiftScenario, interval,),);
    resource.setForScenario("shifts", sas, 0,);

    // sbIdx 10 = 10:00 (shift não cobre, herda workinghours → true)
    assertEquals(scenario.onShift(10,), true,);
    // sbIdx 20 = 20:00 (shift cobre e tem prioridade → true)
    assertEquals(scenario.onShift(20,), true,);
  });
});
```

```ts
import { beforeEach, describe, it, } from "@std/testing/bdd";
import { assert, assertEquals, } from "@std/assert";
import { createTestProject, } from "../fixtures/create-test-project.ts";
import { Project, } from "../../src/model/project.ts";
import { Task, } from "../../src/model/task.ts";
import { TaskScenario, } from "../../src/model/task-scenario.ts";
import { Resource, } from "../../src/model/resource.ts";
import { ResourceScenario, } from "../../src/model/resource-scenario.ts";
import { Account, } from "../../src/model/account.ts";
import { Charge, ChargeMode, } from "../../src/finance/charge.ts";
import { ChargeSet, } from "../../src/finance/charge-set.ts";
import { TjTime, } from "../../src/time/tj-time.ts";

/**
 * Injeta um Charge no atributo `charge` da task.
 *
 * O atributo `charge` é tipado como `{ amount: number }[]` (formato do parser),
 * mas a implementação de `turnover` espera objetos `Charge`. Para testes
 * unitários, injetamos objetos Charge diretamente com um cast.
 */
function injectCharge(
  task: Task,
  amount: number,
  mode: ChargeMode,
  scIdx: number,
): void {
  const charge = new Charge(amount, mode, task, scIdx,);
  // O atributo `charge` espera { amount: number }[] (formato do parser),
  // mas a implementação de `turnover` espera objetos Charge. Injetamos com cast.
  // Acumula no array existente (setForScenario substitui o array inteiro).
  const current = (task.getForScenario("charge", scIdx,) as { amount: number }[] | null) ?? [];
  current.push(charge as unknown as { amount: number });
  task.setForScenario("charge", current, scIdx,);
}

/**
 * Injeta um ChargeSet no atributo `chargeset` da task.
 */
function injectChargeSet(
  task: Task,
  chargeSet: ChargeSet,
  scIdx: number,
): void {
  // O atributo `chargeset` espera ChargeSet[]
  task.setForScenario("chargeset", [chargeSet], scIdx,);
}

/**
 * Reserva os slots do recurso para a tarefa (do start ao end, exclusivo).
 */
function bookResource(
  resourceScenario: ResourceScenario,
  task: Task,
  scIdx: number,
  project: Project,
): void {
  const start = task.getForScenario("start", scIdx,) as TjTime;
  const end = task.getForScenario("end", scIdx,) as TjTime;
  const startIdx = project.dateToIdx(start,);
  const endIdx = project.dateToIdx(end,);
  for (let i = startIdx; i < endIdx; i++) {
    resourceScenario.book(i, task,);
  }
}
```

```ts
import { describe, it, } from "@std/testing/bdd";
import { assertEquals, assertThrows, } from "@std/assert";

import { Rule, } from "../../src/parser/rule.ts";
import { TokenDoc, } from "../../src/lexer/token-doc.ts";

describe("Pattern — estrutura", () => {
  it("parseia tokens com prefixos ! $ _ .", () => {
    const p = new Pattern(["!optionalID", "$STRING", "_accept", ".",],);
    assertEquals(p.tokens[0], ["reference", "optionalID",],);
    assertEquals(p.tokens[1], ["variable", "STRING",],);
    assertEquals(p.tokens[2], ["literal", "accept",],);
    assertEquals(p.tokens[3], ["eof", "<END>",],);
    assertEquals(p.length(), 4,);
  });

  it("lastSyntaxToken inicia no último token", () => {
    const p = new Pattern(["!a", "!b",],);
    assertEquals(p.lastSyntaxToken, 1,);
  });

  it("constructor preserva function passada (bind explícito, não arrow)", () => {
    function action(this: Pattern,) {
      return this === p ? "ok" : "sem bind";
    }
    const p = new Pattern(["!a",], action,);
    assertEquals(p.function, action,);
  });

  it("rejeita token sem prefixo de tipo", () => {
    assertThrows(
      () => new Pattern(["invalid",],),
      Error,
      "must start with a type identifier",
    );
  });

  it("rejeita string vazia como token", () => {
    assertThrows(() => new Pattern(["",],), Error,);
  });

  it("constructor sem function define function null", () => {
    const p = new Pattern(["!a",],);
    assertEquals(p.function, null,);
  });
});

describe("Pattern — documentação", () => {

    const p = new Pattern(["!a",],);
    p.setDoc("task", "A task definition",);
    assertEquals(p.keyword, "task",);
    assertEquals(p.doc, "A task definition",);
  });

  it("setArg define TokenDoc no índice", () => {
    const p = new Pattern(["$STRING", "_task",],);
    const doc = new TokenDoc("text", "<text>",);
    p.setArg(0, doc,);
    assertEquals(p.args[0], doc,);
    assertEquals(p.args[1], null,);
  });

  it("setLastSyntaxToken redefine o último token sintático", () => {
    const p = new Pattern(["!a", "!b", "!c",],);
    p.setLastSyntaxToken(1,);
    assertEquals(p.lastSyntaxToken, 1,);
  });

  it("setSupportLevel e setSeeAlso e setExample", () => {
    const p = new Pattern(["!a",],);
    p.setSupportLevel("experimental",);
    p.setSeeAlso(["flag", "spec",],);
    p.setExample("mwe001", "task",);
    assertEquals(p.supportLevel, "experimental",);
    assertEquals(p.seeAlso, ["flag", "spec",],);
    assertEquals(p.exampleFile, "mwe001",);
    assertEquals(p.exampleTag, "task",);
  });
});

describe("Pattern — acessores", () => {
  it("get retorna token no índice", () => {
    const p = new Pattern(["!a", "$B",],);
    assertEquals(p.get(1,), ["variable", "B",],);
  });

  it("get lança para índice fora da faixa", () => {
    const p = new Pattern(["!a",],);
    assertThrows(() => p.get(5,), Error, "out of range",);
  });

  it("each itera os tokens", () => {
    const p = new Pattern(["!a", "!b",],);
    assertEquals([...p.each(),], [["reference", "a",], ["reference", "b",],],);
  });

  it("empty e length", () => {
    assertEquals(new Pattern([],).empty(), true,);
    assertEquals(new Pattern(["!a",],).empty(), false,);
    assertEquals(new Pattern(["!a", "!b",],).length(), 2,);
  });
});

describe("Pattern — análise estrutural", () => {
  it("isOptional: literal torna o pattern não-opcional", () => {
    const p = new Pattern(["_foo",],);
    assertEquals(p.optional(new Map(),), false,);
  });

  it("isOptional: variável torna o pattern não-opcional", () => {
    const p = new Pattern(["$STRING",],);
    assertEquals(p.optional(new Map(),), false,);
  });

  it("isOptional: referências opcionais tornam o pattern opcional", () => {
    const opt = new Rule("opt",);
    opt.setOptional();
    const rules = new Map<string, Rule>([["opt", opt,],],);
    const p = new Pattern(["!opt", "!opt",],);
    assertEquals(p.optional(rules,), true,);
  });

  it("terminalSymbol identifica variável e literal", () => {
    const p = new Pattern(["$STRING", "_task", "!ref",],);
    assertEquals(p.terminalSymbol(0,), true,);
    assertEquals(p.terminalSymbol(1,), true,);
    assertEquals(p.terminalSymbol(2,), false,);
  });

  it("terminalSymbol retorna false fora da faixa", () => {
    const p = new Pattern(["$STRING",],);
    assertEquals(p.terminalSymbol(3,), false,);
  });

  it("terminalTokens: literal retorna par [nome, pattern]", () => {
    const p = new Pattern(["_task",],);
    assertEquals(p.terminalTokens(new Map(),), [["task", p,],],);
  });

  it("terminalTokens: variável retorna lista vazia", () => {
    const p = new Pattern(["$STRING",],);
    assertEquals(p.terminalTokens(new Map(),), [],);
  });

  it("terminalTokens: referência expande recursivamente", () => {
    const inner = new Rule("inner",);
    inner.addPattern(new Pattern(["_a",],),);
    inner.addPattern(new Pattern(["_b",],),);
    const rules = new Map<string, Rule>([["inner", inner,],],);
    const p = new Pattern(["!inner",],);
    const tts = p.terminalTokens(rules,);
    assertEquals(tts.map((t,) => t[0]), ["a", "b",],);
  });

  it("generateStates cria um State por token", () => {
    const rule = new Rule("r",);
    const p = new Pattern(["$A", "$B",],);
    rule.addPattern(p,);
    const states = p.generateStates(rule, new Map(),);
    assertEquals(states.length, 2,);
    assertEquals(states[0]!.index, 0,);
    assertEquals(states[1]!.pattern, p,);
  });

  it("generateStates marca cauda reducionista com noReduce=false (Ruby l.129)", () => {
    const opt = new Rule("opt",);
    opt.setOptional();
    const rules = new Map<string, Rule>([["opt", opt,],],);
    const rule = new Rule("r",);
    const p = new Pattern(["$A", "!opt",],);
    rule.addPattern(p,);
    const states = p.generateStates(rule, rules,);
    // token 1 (!opt) é opcional da cauda e o token 0 passa a ser o primeiro
    // redutível → ambos os estados recebem noReduce=false (fiel ao Ruby)
    assertEquals(states[1]!.noReduce, false,);
    assertEquals(states[0]!.noReduce, false,);
  });
});

describe("Pattern — serialização", () => {
  it("to_s renderiza prefixos Ruby", () => {
    const p = new Pattern(["!ref", "$var", "_lit", ".",],);
    assertEquals(p.to_s(), "!ref $var lit . ",);
  });

  it("to_syntax renderiza variáveis entre <>", () => {
    const rule = new Rule("r",);
    const p = new Pattern(["_task", "$STRING",],);
    rule.addPattern(p,);
    const rules = new Map<string, Rule>([["r", rule,],],);
    assertEquals(p.to_syntax([], rules,), "task <STRING>",);
  });

  it("to_syntax com TokenDoc usa <name> e popula argDocs", () => {
    const rule = new Rule("r",);
    const p = new Pattern(["$STRING",],);
    p.setArg(0, new TokenDoc("taskName", "<text>",),);
    rule.addPattern(p,);
    const rules = new Map<string, Rule>([["r", rule,],],);
    const argDocs: TokenDoc[] = [];
    assertEquals(p.to_syntax(argDocs, rules,), "<taskName>",);
    assertEquals(argDocs.length, 1,);
  });

  it("addArgDoc via setArg não duplica (to_syntax dedupe por name)", () => {
    const rule = new Rule("r",);
    const p = new Pattern(["$STRING", "$ID",],);
    // Dois TokenDocs com o mesmo name: dedupe por name em argDocs
    p.setArg(0, new TokenDoc("x", "<x>",),);
    p.setArg(1, new TokenDoc("x", "<x dup>",),);
    rule.addPattern(p,);
    const rules = new Map<string, Rule>([["r", rule,],],);
    const argDocs: TokenDoc[] = [];
    p.to_syntax(argDocs, rules,);
    assertEquals(argDocs.length, 1,);
  });
});
```

```ts
/**
 * Testes da subfase 10.10 — ProjectFileParser (estrutura).
 *
 * Cobre campos, constructor, open/close, delegação de tokens, macros
 * globais, file stack e as conveniências de regras (singlePattern,
 * listRule, optionsRule...) usadas pelo TjpSyntaxRules (10.11+).
 *
 * @see docs/syntaxmesh/fases/fase-10-parser-linguagem-tarefas.md §10.10
 */
import { assert, assertEquals, assertThrows, } from "@std/assert";
import { describe, it, } from "@std/testing/bdd";
import { MessageHandlerInstance, } from "../../src/message-handler.ts";
import { AttributeBase, } from "../../src/attributes/attribute-base.ts";
import { detectLanguage, ProjectFileParser, } from "../../src/parser/mod.ts";
import type { ParserToken, } from "../../src/parser/text-parser.ts";
import { FileStreamHandle, } from "../../src/lexer/stream-handle.ts";
import { NotYetImplementedError, } from "../../src/model/errors.ts";
import { Project, } from "../../src/model/project.ts";
import { PropertyTreeNode, } from "../../src/model/property-tree-node.ts";
import { Task, } from "../../src/model/task.ts";
import { TimeInterval, } from "../../src/time/time-interval.ts";
import { TjTime, } from "../../src/time/tj-time.ts";

function resetMessages(): void {
  MessageHandlerInstance.instance.messages.length = 0;
  MessageHandlerInstance.instance.errors = 0;
}

function messageIds(): string[] {
  return MessageHandlerInstance.instance.messages.map((m,) => m.id);
}

/** Expõe os métodos protegidos de tokens para verificação direta. */
class TokenProbeParser extends ProjectFileParser {
  next(): ParserToken {
    return this.nextToken();
  }

  pushBack(token: ParserToken | null,): void {
    this.returnToken(token,);
  }

  useFileStack(): void {
    this.initFileStack();
  }

  pushStack(): void {
    this.pushFileStack();
  }

  popStack(): void {
    this.popFileStack();
  }
}

describe("ProjectFileParser — campos e constructor (10.10.1)", () => {
  it("variables lista os 11 tipos de token do scanner TJP", () => {
    const parser = new ProjectFileParser();
    assertEquals(parser.variables, [
      "INTEGER",
      "FLOAT",
      "DATE",
      "TIME",
      "STRING",
      "LITERAL",
      "ID",
      "ID_WITH_COLON",
      "ABSOLUTE_ID",
      "MACRO",
      "KEYWORD",
    ],);
  });

  it("constructor define language='en' e AttributeBase.setMode(0)", () => {
    AttributeBase.setMode(2,);
    const parser = new ProjectFileParser();
    assertEquals(parser.language, "en",);
    assertEquals(AttributeBase.mode, 0,);
  });

  it("campos de estado começam em branco/zero", () => {
    const parser = new ProjectFileParser();
    assertEquals(parser.project, null,);
    assertEquals(parser.property, null,);
    assertEquals(parser.scenarioIdx, 0,);
    assertEquals(parser.taskprefix, "",);
    assertEquals(parser.reportprefix, "",);
    assertEquals(parser.resourceprefix, "",);
    assertEquals(parser.accountprefix, "",);
    assertEquals(parser.reportCounter, 0,);
    assertEquals(parser.projectId, "",);
    assertEquals(parser.limitResources, [],);
  });
});

describe("ProjectFileParser — open/close (10.10.2)", () => {
  it("abre um buffer e tokeniza o primeiro ID", () => {
    resetMessages();
    // O scanner interno entrega os tokens do buffer.
    const probe = new TokenProbeParser();
    probe.open("task { }", true, true,);
    assertEquals(probe.next()[0], "ID",);
    probe.close();
  });

  it("open de arquivo mestre sem extensão .tjp registra illegal_extension", () => {
    resetMessages();
    FileStreamHandle.fileLoader = () => 'project p "P" 1.0 2026-01-01';

      parser.close();

    }
  });

  it("open com master detecta a diretiva language (10.17)", () => {

    assertEquals(parser.language, "pt-BR",);

  });

  it("idioma desconhecido cai para 'en' com warning language_unknown", () => {

  it("close limpa o scanner; nextToken após close devolve endOfText", () => {
```

```ts
import { describe, it, } from "@std/testing/bdd";
import { assertEquals, assertThrows, } from "@std/assert";
import {
  State,
  stateKeyOf,
  type StateKeys,
  StateTransition,
} from "../../src/parser/state.ts";
import { Rule, } from "../../src/parser/rule.ts";
import { Pattern, } from "../../src/parser/pattern.ts";

/** Compila um mini-FSM para um conjunto de regras (como updateParserTables). */
function buildFSM(rules: Map<string, Rule>,): {
  states: Map<string, State>;
  keys: StateKeys;
} {
  const keys: StateKeys = new Map();
  const states = new Map<string, State>();
  for (const rule of rules.values()) {
    for (const s of rule.generateStates(rules,)) {
      states.set(stateKeyOf(rule, s.pattern, s.index, keys,), s,);
    }
  }
  for (const s of states.values()) {
    s.addTransitions(states, rules, keys,);
  }
  return { states, keys, };
}

/** Chave de um estado específico, usando o mesmo mapa de identidade. */
function keyOf(
  keys: StateKeys,
  rule: Rule,
  pattern: Pattern | null,
  index: number,
): string {
  return stateKeyOf(rule, pattern, index, keys,);
}

    );
  });

    from.addTransition(["literal", "accept",], litState, [], false,);
    from.addTransition(["variable", "ID",], idState, [], false,);
    assertEquals(from.transition(["ID", "accept",],)?.state, litState,);
    assertEquals(from.transition(["ID", "qualquer",],)?.state, idState,);
  });

  it("transition para LITERAL busca pelo nome do token", () => {
    const rule = new Rule("r",);
    const from = new State(rule,);
    const to = new State(rule,);
    from.addTransition(["literal", "{",], to, [], false,);

    assertEquals(from.transition(["LITERAL", "}",],), null,);

    assertEquals(from.expectedTokens().sort(), ["'STRING'", "'x'",],);
  });

describe("State — integração FSM (addTransitions)", () => {
  it("FSM de 'a b' encadeia starting → 0 → 1 → eof", () => {
    const rule = new Rule("ab",);
    rule.addPattern(new Pattern(["_a", "_b",],),);
    const rules = new Map<string, Rule>([["ab", rule,],],);
    const { states, keys, } = buildFSM(rules,);

    const start = states.get(keyOf(keys, rule, null, 0,),)!;
    const trA = start.transition(["LITERAL", "a",],)!;
    assertEquals(trA.state.index, 0,);

    const trB = trA.state.transition(["LITERAL", "b",],)!;
    assertEquals(trB.state.index, 1,);
    // Ruby não cria transição explícita para eof no último token; o EOF é
    // tratado pelo parseFSM via reduce (finishPattern). O último estado é
    // redutível (noReduce=false).
    assertEquals(trB.state.transition(["eof", "<END>",],), null,);
    assertEquals(trB.state.noReduce, false,);
  });

  it("FSM com referência !word expande transições da regra referenciada", () => {
    const word = new Rule("word",);
    word.addPattern(new Pattern(["_hello",],),);
    const sentence = new Rule("sentence",);
    sentence.addPattern(new Pattern(["!word", "_end",],),);
    const rules = new Map(
      [["word", word,], ["sentence", sentence,],],
    );
    const { states, keys, } = buildFSM(rules,);

    const start = states.get(keyOf(keys, sentence, null, 0,),)!;
    assertEquals(start.transition(["LITERAL", "hello",],)?.state.index, 0,);
  });

  it("ambiguidade é detectada na compilação do FSM", () => {
    const r = new Rule("amb",);
    r.addPattern(new Pattern(["_x", "_a",],),);
    r.addPattern(new Pattern(["_x", "_b",],),);
    const rules = new Map<string, Rule>([["amb", r,],],);
    assertThrows(() => buildFSM(rules,), Error, "Ambiguous",);
  });
});
```

```ts
import { describe, it, } from "@std/testing/bdd";
import { assertEquals, assertThrows, } from "@std/assert";
import { MessageHandlerInstance, } from "../../src/message-handler.ts";
import { SourceFileInfo, } from "../../src/source-file-info.ts";
import { State, } from "../../src/parser/state.ts";
import { StackElement, } from "../../src/parser/stack-element.ts";
import { AttributeOverwrite, TjError, } from "../../src/model/errors.ts";
import {
  type ParserToken,
  TextParser,
  tokenTypeToInt,
} from "../../src/parser/text-parser.ts";

function sfi(line = 1,): SourceFileInfo {
  return new SourceFileInfo("test.tjp", line, 0,);
}

/**
 * TestParser — parser mínimo com fila de tokens embutida (tarefa 10.7.5.6).
 * Substitui o Scanner do Ruby: nextToken/returnToken operam sobre uma fila.
 */
class TestParser extends TextParser {
  private queue: ParserToken[] = [];
  returned: Array<ParserToken | null> = [];

  constructor() {
    super();
    this.variables = ["ID", "KEYWORD", "STRING", "endOfText",];
    this.ruleMethods = ["rule_top", "rule_child", "rule_hello",];
  }

  feed(...tokens: ParserToken[]): void {
    this.queue.push(...tokens,);
  }

  queueIsEmpty(): boolean {
    return this.queue.length === 0;
  }

  /** Expõe (debug) o estado do topo da pilha do FSM. */
  stackTopState(): unknown {
    return this.stack ? this.stack[this.stack.length - 1]?.state : undefined;
  }

  /** Força uma pilha com um State real, como durante um parse. */
  seedStackWithState(): void {
    const state = [...this.states.values(),].find(
      (s,) => s.pattern !== null && s.index === 0,
    )!;
    this.stack = [new StackElement(null, state,),];
  }

  /** Empilha um StackElement com função/estado/valores explícitos. */
  pushRawStackElement(
    fn: ((...args: unknown[]) => unknown) | null,
    state: unknown,
    values: Array<[unknown, SourceFileInfo | null,]>,
  ): void {
    this.stack ??= [];
    const el = new StackElement(fn, state,);
    values.forEach(([v, s,], i,) => {
      el.insert(i, v, s, false,);
    },);
    this.stack.push(el,);
  }

  /** Wrapper público para saveFsmStack (privado na classe base). */
  invokeSaveFsmStack(): void {
    (this as unknown as { saveFsmStack: () => void }).saveFsmStack();
  }

  /** Wrapper público para restoreFsmStack (privado na classe base). */
  invokeRestoreFsmStack(): void {
    (this as unknown as { restoreFsmStack: () => void }).restoreFsmStack();
  }

  invokeDumpStack(): string {
    return this.dumpStack();
  }

  protected nextToken(): ParserToken {
    const t = this.queue.shift();
    if (!t) {
      return ["endOfText", "<END>", null,];
    }
    return t;
  }

  protected returnToken(token: ParserToken | null,): void {
    this.returned.push(token,);
    if (token) {
      this.queue.unshift(token,);
    }
  }

  rule_top(): void {
    this.pattern(["$ID", "_end",], function (this: TestParser,) {
      return `top:${String(this.val[0],)}:${String(this.val[1],)}`;
    },);
  }

  rule_child(): void {
    this.pattern(["_kw", "$STRING",], function (this: TestParser,) {
      return `child:${String(this.val[1],)}`;
    },);
  }

  rule_hello(): void {
    this.pattern(["_hello",], function (this: TestParser,) {
      return `hello:${String(this.val[0],)}`;
    },);
  }
}

function freshHandler(): MessageHandlerInstance {
  const mh = MessageHandlerInstance.instance;
  mh.reset();
  return mh;
}

function compiled(): TestParser {
  const p = new TestParser();
  p.initRules();
  p.updateParserTables();
  return p;
}
```

```ts
} from "../src/model/property-tree-node.ts";
import { PropertyList, } from "../src/model/property-list.ts";

class TestProperty extends PropertyTreeNode {
  constructor(
    propertySet: PropertySet,
    id: string | null,
    name: string,
    parent: PropertyTreeNode | null,
  ) {
    super(propertySet, id, name, parent,);
  }
}

describe("PropertyList", () => {
  let project: Project;
  let propertySet: PropertySet;

  beforeEach(() => {
    project = createTestProject();
    propertySet = new PropertySet(project, false,);
  },);

  it("push adiciona item", () => {
    const list = new PropertyList<TestProperty>(propertySet,);
    const root = new TestProperty(propertySet, null, "root", null,);
    list.push(root,);
    assertEquals(list.length(), 1,);
    assertEquals(list.get(0,), root,);
  });

  it("get retorna item por índice", () => {
    const list = new PropertyList<TestProperty>(propertySet,);
    const root = new TestProperty(propertySet, null, "root", null,);
    list.push(root,);
    assertEquals(list.get(0,), root,);
  });

  it("includes verifica presença", () => {
    const list = new PropertyList<TestProperty>(propertySet,);
    const root = new TestProperty(propertySet, null, "root", null,);
    list.push(root,);
    assertEquals(list.includes(root,), true,);
    assertEquals(
      list.includes(new TestProperty(propertySet, null, "other", null,),),
      false,
    );
  });

  it("find retorna item correspondente", () => {
    const list = new PropertyList<TestProperty>(propertySet,);
    const root = new TestProperty(propertySet, null, "root", null,);
    const child = new TestProperty(propertySet, null, "child", root,);
    list.push(root,);
    list.push(child,);
    assertEquals(list.find((item,) => item.name === "child"), child,);
    assertEquals(list.find((item,) => item.name === "nonexistent"), null,);
  });

  it("delete remove item", () => {
    const list = new PropertyList<TestProperty>(propertySet,);
    const root = new TestProperty(propertySet, null, "root", null,);
    list.push(root,);
    assertEquals(list.length(), 1,);
    list.delete(0,);
    assertEquals(list.length(), 0,);
  });

  it("clear remove todos os itens", () => {
    const list = new PropertyList<TestProperty>(propertySet,);
    const root = new TestProperty(propertySet, null, "root", null,);
    const child = new TestProperty(propertySet, null, "child", root,);
    list.push(root,);
    list.push(child,);
    assertEquals(list.length(), 2,);
    list.clear();
    assertEquals(list.length(), 0,);
  });

  it("toArray retorna cópia do array", () => {
    const list = new PropertyList<TestProperty>(propertySet,);
    const root = new TestProperty(propertySet, null, "root", null,);
    list.push(root,);
    const array = list.toArray();
    assertEquals(array.length, 1,);
    assertEquals(array[0], root,);
    // Modificar o array original não deve afetar a PropertyList
    array.push(new TestProperty(propertySet, null, "extra", null,),);
    assertEquals(list.length(), 1,);
  });

  it("iterator itera sobre itens", () => {
    const list = new PropertyList<TestProperty>(propertySet,);
    const root = new TestProperty(propertySet, null, "root", null,);
    const child = new TestProperty(propertySet, null, "child", root,);
    list.push(root,);
    list.push(child,);
    const items = [];
    for (const item of list) {
      items.push(item,);
    }
    assertEquals(items.length, 2,);
    assertEquals(items[0], root,);
    assertEquals(items[1], child,);
  });
});
```

```ts
      assert(result[2] === r2, `expected r2 third, got ${result[2]?.id}`,);
    });

    it("ordena por bookedEffort descendente para MaxLoaded", () => {
      (r1.scenarioData(0,) as ResourceScenario).setEffort(0,);
      (r2.scenarioData(0,) as ResourceScenario).setEffort(5,);
      (r3.scenarioData(0,) as ResourceScenario).setEffort(2,);
```

```ts
import { beforeEach, describe, it, } from "@std/testing/bdd";
import { assert, assertEquals, } from "@std/assert";
```

```ts
describe("DataCache", () => {

    cache.reset();
  },);

  it("constructor inicializa cache vazio", () => {

    assertEquals(cache.missCount, 0,);

  });

    assertEquals(result, "value1",);

    assertEquals(cache.missCount, 1,);
  });

  it("cached retorna valor armazenado se presente", () => {
    cache.cached(["key1",], () => "value1",);
    const result = cache.cached(["key1",], () => "value2",);
    assertEquals(result, "value1",);
    assertEquals(cache.hitCount, 1,);
    assertEquals(cache.missCount, 1,);
  });

  it("cached computa valor para args complexos", () => {
    const args = ["key", 123, { nested: "object", }, [1, 2, 3,],];
    const result = cache.cached(args, () => "complexValue",);
    assertEquals(result, "complexValue",);
    assertEquals(cache.entryCount, 1,);
  });

  it("cached respeita limite de tamanho (highWaterMark)", () => {
    cache.resize(10,);
    for (let i = 0; i < 25; i++) {
      cache.cached([i,], () => `value${i}`,);
    }
    // Eviction keeps size bounded at highWaterMark.
    assert(cache.entryCount <= 10,);
    assert(cache.entryCount > 0,);
  });

  it("toString retorna estatísticas", () => {

    cache.cached(["key1",], () => "value1",);

    assert(stats.includes("Stores: 1",),);
    assert(stats.includes("Hits: 1",),);
    assert(stats.includes("Misses: 1",),);
  });

  it("entryCount retorna número de entradas", () => {
    assertEquals(cache.entryCount, 0,);
    cache.cached(["key1",], () => "value1",);
    assertEquals(cache.entryCount, 1,);
    cache.cached(["key2",], () => "value2",);
    assertEquals(cache.entryCount, 2,);
  });

  it("hitCount retorna número de hits", () => {
    assertEquals(cache.hitCount, 0,);
    cache.cached(["key1",], () => "value1",);
    cache.cached(["key1",], () => "value2",);
    assertEquals(cache.hitCount, 1,);
  });

  it("missCount retorna número de misses", () => {

    cache.cached(["key2",], () => "value2",);
    assertEquals(cache.missCount, 2,);
  });

  it("collisionCount retorna número de colisões", () => {
    assertEquals(cache.collisionCount, 0,);
    cache.cached(["key1",], () => "value1",);
    cache.cached(["key2",], () => "value2",);
    assertEquals(cache.collisionCount, 0,);
  });

  it("cached computa valor para null e undefined", () => {
    const result1 = cache.cached(["keyNull",], () => null,);
    const result2 = cache.cached(["keyUndefined",], () => undefined,);
    assertEquals(result1, null,);

    assertEquals(cache.entryCount, 2,);
  });

  it("cached computa valor para função que retorna undefined", () => {
    const result = cache.cached(["key1",], () => undefined,);
    assertEquals(result, undefined,);
    assertEquals(cache.entryCount, 1,);
  });

  it("cached computa valor para função que retorna null", () => {

  });

  it("cached computa valor para função que retorna objeto", () => {
```

```ts
import { beforeEach, describe, it, } from "@std/testing/bdd";
import { assert, assertEquals, } from "@std/assert";
```

```ts
import { TaskDependency, } from "../../src/scheduling/task-dependency.ts";

describe("TaskDependency", () => {
  let project: Project;
  let task1: Task;
  let task2: Task;

  beforeEach(() => {
    project = createTestProject(1,);
    task1 = new Task(project, "t1", "Task 1", null,);
    task2 = new Task(project, "t2", "Task 2", null,);
  },);

  it("constructor cria TaskDependency com taskId e onEnd", () => {
    const dep = new TaskDependency("t1", true,);
    assertEquals(dep.taskId, "t1",);
    assertEquals(dep.onEnd, true,);
    assertEquals(dep.task, null,);
    assertEquals(dep.gapDuration, 0,);
    assertEquals(dep.gapLength, 0,);
  });

  it("equals retorna true para dependências iguais", () => {
    const dep1 = new TaskDependency("t1", true,);
    dep1.gapDuration = 3600;
    dep1.gapLength = 2;
    const dep2 = new TaskDependency("t1", true,);
    dep2.gapDuration = 3600;
    dep2.gapLength = 2;
    assertEquals(dep1.equals(dep2,), true,);
  });

  it("equals retorna false para dependências com taskId diferente", () => {
    const dep1 = new TaskDependency("t1", true,);
    const dep2 = new TaskDependency("t2", true,);
    assertEquals(dep1.equals(dep2,), false,);
  });

  it("equals retorna false para dependências com onEnd diferente", () => {
    const dep1 = new TaskDependency("t1", true,);
    const dep2 = new TaskDependency("t1", false,);
    assertEquals(dep1.equals(dep2,), false,);
  });

  it("equals retorna false para dependências com gapDuration diferente", () => {
    const dep1 = new TaskDependency("t1", true,);
    dep1.gapDuration = 3600;
    const dep2 = new TaskDependency("t1", true,);
    dep2.gapDuration = 7200;
    assertEquals(dep1.equals(dep2,), false,);
  });

  it("equals retorna false para dependências com gapLength diferente", () => {
    const dep1 = new TaskDependency("t1", true,);
    dep1.gapLength = 2;
    const dep2 = new TaskDependency("t1", true,);
    dep2.gapLength = 3;
    assertEquals(dep1.equals(dep2,), false,);
  });

  it("resolve resolve taskId para Task existente", () => {
    const dep = new TaskDependency("t1", true,);
    const resolved = dep.resolve(project,);

    });
```

```ts
      b.push(new Interval(2, 3,),);
      const res = a.intersect(b,);
      assertEquals(res.length, 0,);
      assertEquals(res instanceof IntervalList, true,);
    });

      const b = new IntervalList<Interval<number>>();

      assertEquals(res[0]!.start, 2,);
      assertEquals(res[0]!.end, 3,);

      assertEquals(res[0]!.start, 0,);
      assertEquals(res[0]!.end, 3,);

    it("works with TjTime", () => {
```
